values.Brandenburg, KY.json|description: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> BRANDENBURG <LINE> <LINE><LEFT> <SIZE:small>  Brandenburg lies on the south bank of the Ohio, and was a popular destination in the steamboat era, a relic of which is the recently docked PS Delilah. <LINE> But an illustrious past doesn't mean this is a backwards-looking town. <LINE> <LINE> While still recovering from the effects of a tornado in April, the town boasts the sprawling Pondview Shopping Center, and the old fire chief's Five Alarm Firehouse Chili draws spice-seekers from across the state!
values.Challenge.json|Challenge_YouHaveOneDay_d: You're back in Knox County, the map where the Project Zomboid infection first began. <LINE> <LINE> You have one day of relative safety. Then the zombies will arrive in huge numbers, and they WILL find you. Where did you make your last stand in the old days? Better find it quick. <LINE> <LINE> [Our thanks to Community mapper BobHeckling for recreating the old 0.1.5 map with the current PZ toolset!]
values.Challenge.json|Challenge_WinterIsComing_: It's mid-July, but soon, a winter like no other before it will set in. <LINE> The undead hordes might be slowed by the intense cold - but they are no less deadly.
values.Challenge.json|Challenge_OpeningHours_de: Once upon a time, The Mall was an important place in their lives. Instinct has led them to its doors. A memory of what they used to do... <LINE> <LINE> You are alone, but not for long. At 9AM the Mall will be ready for business: the doors will open, and the hordes will enter. The only bargain they're looking for is your tasty flesh! <LINE> <LINE> Shop 'til you drop, survivor.
values.Challenge.json|Challenge_AReallyCDDAy_de: You get out of the shower and fall badly. You're blind drunk, and have a nasty cold. <LINE> Oh and the house is on fire! And, well, zombies.
values.Challenge.json|Challenge_Challenge1_name: House in the Woods - Last Stand
values.Challenge.json|Challenge_Challenge1_desc: You thought you were safe out here, in the middle of nowhere. Now, you can hear moans throughout the forest. Hordes of deadheads, encroaching on your isolated cabin from every angle, waiting to feast on your delicious flesh. Death is inevitable, but a shotgun is close at hand. <LINE> <LINE> Last Stand features endless waves of zombies in ever-increasing numbers. Survive for as long as possible against the overwhelming odds.
values.Challenge.json|Challenge_Challenge2_desc: Endless waves of zombies in ever-increasing numbers. <LINE> Use money earned by killing zeds to buy equipment, level up skills, and repair your gear.
values.Challenge.json|Challenge_AStormIsComing_: Clouds are gathering over Kentucky. The crackle of thunder can be heard in the distance. <LINE> <LINE> As skies darken, the dead that stumble over the earth grow restless. <LINE> <LINE> This is a storm that will grow and fall back in its ferocity, but it will never end.
values.Challenge.json|Challenge_TheDescendingFo: People first saw it on the water. A faint white blanket over the Ohio river. <LINE> <LINE> It began as a mist. Then it enveloped the town. The townsfolk died screaming in the gloom. Now they walk out there. <LINE> <LINE> Unseen, unheard and relentless in the pursuit of the living.
values.Challenge.json|Challenge_Kingsmouth_desc: Escape from the world in our tropical paradise! Explore a unique island with a sprawling four-story resort, bungalows on a private boardwalk, a small town filled with friendly locals, and more! <LINE><LINE> For fishing, swimming, the best food and drink, or simple relaxation, there's no place like Kingsmouth. Just remember to bring your sunblock! <LINE><LINE>
values.Challenge.json|Challenge_Studio_desc: Tours of the Mountain Lion Pictures Studios backlot are now available! See where classic movies such as CyberKiller 2, Mother's Boy, and The Dog Goblin were filmed. <LINE><LINE>Explore our sets such as Town, Graveyard, Spooky Cabin, and more. Become the star of classic movies using our bluescreens. Shoot replicas of classic weapons like "Filthy" Larry Salatch's Magnum or CyberKiller's sawed-off JS2000 at our firing range. You might even see a famous face or two! <LINE><LINE> PLEASE NOTE: Tours only take place at night. Our casts and crew members can get a little jumped up on caffeine during daylight hours!
values.Challenge.json|Challenge_Challenge2_Pres: Press "o" for permanent boost and to spend some money.
values.Challenge.json|Challenge_OpeningHoursInf: <CENTRE> The Mall opens at 9AM. <LINE> <LINE> Get ready for the crowds...
values.Challenge.json|Challenge_WinterIsComingI: <CENTRE> In three days the endless winter begins. <LINE> <LINE> Wrap up warm...
values.Challenge.json|Challenge_YouHaveOneDayIn: <CENTRE> In 24 hours your trip back to Knox County will become Hell on Earth...
values.Challenge.json|Challenge_TopOfTheWorld_d: A fancy party in the penthouse atop the Louisville Bateman Building, taking in the amazing views and rubbing elbows with the city's rich and elite?  What an amazing night! <LINE> But you had a bit too much to drink and needed to lie down. Hold on…what's that banging noise outside the door?
values.Challenge.json|Challenge_TwentyEightMinu: You awake in a doctor's examination room.  The world is unusually quiet.  In the distance, a scream echoes…and then another.  They are getting closer.  Fast. <LINE> Run.

values.Echo Creek, KY.json|description: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> ECHO CREEK - NEW <LINE> <LINE><LEFT> <SIZE:small> Echo Creek is a humble town - the people here farm, pray, and like to keep to themselves - but it's rural Kentucky at its finest, and the perfect location for those wanting to explore the western reaches of Knox Country. <LINE> <LINE> Venture west to Ekron, take a trip south to Irvington and its famous speedway, or head north to Brandenburg. <LINE> <LINE> No matter which way you go, it'll be the trip of a lifetime!
values.Ekron, KY.json|description: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> EKRON <LINE> <LINE><LEFT> <SIZE:small> With a population of under two hundred, Ekron is a place where the locals won't bother you. <LINE> <LINE> Most of the residents work in the AMZ Steelworks plant, or make the daily commute to Brandenburg to the north or Irvington to the south. <LINE> <LINE> They don't get a lot of time to relax but don't worry - they'll always make time for a chat over your backyard fence!
values.Entity.json|EC_CraftLogicTooltip_NoOutpu: No valid output for the provided inputs.
values.Fallas Lake, KY.json|description: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> FALLAS LAKE <LINE> <LINE><LEFT> <SIZE:small> There are three types of people in Fallas Lake - farmers, lake fishers, and people passing through on the way to Rosewood to the south, or Riverside to the north. <LINE> <LINE> But linger for a while in its charming streets and you may find a peace and serenity forever out of grasp in Kentucky's larger towns and cities.

values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Welcome1: <CENTRE> <SIZE:large> Welcome to Project Zomboid! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:medium> Soon, you'll die horribly. No one will mourn you, and you will be swiftly forgotten. Everything will have been for nothing! <LINE> <LINE> So let's make sure you go out fighting!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Welcome2: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> First things first: you can zoom with your mouse wheel or the %1/%2 keys. <LINE> <LINE> Let's get a bird's eye view of the lonely place where you're about to die - miserable and alone! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Zoom out!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Welcome3: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> You're great at this! <LINE> <LINE> Let's have a look at your character information. <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Click the flashing Heart over on the left!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Welcome4: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Here you see your Health status. <LINE> <LINE> Scratches, bites, bleeding, broken limbs: all listed for your convenience! <LINE> <LINE> It's also here that you can bandage and treat wounds.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Welcome5: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Do you know another good panel? Yes! The Skills Panel! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Click on the Skills tab, please!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Welcome6: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Awesome! It really will be SUCH a shame to lose you! <LINE> <LINE> This panel shows your points in various different survival skills.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Welcome7: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> In-game activities build up Skill Points that level you up in each discipline. <LINE> <LINE> Learning speeds can be increased by reading books and watching certain TV shows! <LINE> <LINE> Ultimately your brain will become cold, dead sludge - but in the meantime why not learn carpentry?
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Welcome8: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Time to take off those training wheels, lady! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Close the Character Panel by clicking the cross, and we'll move onto the next exciting aspect of survivor life!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Welcome9: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> It's... looking at stuff! Woo! <LINE> <LINE> Hold down the Right Mouse Button and move the mouse. <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> You'll turn to face ANY angle! (Holding LEFT CTRL and moving the mouse will do this too!)
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Welcome10: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> PLOT TWIST! <LINE> <LINE> You can only see in the direction you're facing! <LINE> <LINE> Swift and unexpected death can come from behind: whether from the undead host, or your fellow man.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_WalkTo1: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Let's get some blood pumping, before it congeals and rots! <LINE> <LINE> Move around with the %1 keys. <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Why not walk into the adjacent room? It's definitely safe!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_WalkTo2: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> See! Told you it was safe! <LINE> <LINE> Now, let's strafe! Holding the Right Mouse Button will let you look around while walking. <LINE> This will help you line up attacks and watch your back. <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Strafe further into the room by holding the Right Mouse Button and moving using %1!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_WalkTo3: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Dead person alert! <LINE> <LINE> You're going to have to do some looting if you want to survive an attack! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Head back to the marked counter in the kitchen, and we'll learn to steal!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_InvLoot1: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Starvation can be delayed by looting food from the homes of the recently deceased! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Move your mouse over the Loot Panel, and expand it.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_InvLoot2: <CENTRE> <SIZE:large> A dead rat! <SIZE:medium> <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> To pick it up, let's double click!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_InvLoot3: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> We should probably pick up that Empty Jar too. Dying of thirst is horrid. <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Double click the Empty Jar!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_InvUse1: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> See those Moodles to the right? <LINE> Looks like someone's got a rumbly tummy! Time to eat! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Right click on the dead rat in your inventory to see interaction options! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Eat the dead rat!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_InvUse2: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> That's better! Apart from the nausea... <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:medium> To learn about what each Moodle means, move your cursor over them!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_InvUse2Bis: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Oh hey, better fill up your jar before the water supply is cut off. <LINE> <LINE> Right clicking items in the world will bring up interaction options! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Move next to the sink and right click it to fill the jar.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_InvUse3: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> You automatically drink from water that's carried in your main inventory. <LINE> <LINE> Let's see what's in the other cupboards! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Open that awesome Loot Panel again!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_InvUse4: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> You can look in nearby containers by walking close to them with the Loot Panel open. <LINE> <LINE> Every container within reach can be opened with a Left Click on the flashing container icons. <LINE> <LINE> Conveniently enough, there's a weapon hidden for you nearby! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Loot the surrounding containers to find a weapon!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_InvUse5: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Well, it's near enough a weapon! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Right click the Frying Pan and select "Equip Primary" so you can use it on all the dead folk you meet!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_InvUse6: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> All of it please. We don't have time for this.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_InvUse7: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> No. The whole thing. <LINE> <LINE> Don't try to be smart. There's plenty more like you.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Fight1: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Oh my! Is it getting hot in here? <LINE> <LINE> Let's pop open a window and get some fresh air while your lungs are still inflated! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Walk to the flashing window behind you!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Fight2: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> A zombie in a hat! <LINE> <LINE> Let's get out there! Pressing %1 will interact with objects in front of you. Most notably: doors and windows! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Press %1 to open the window!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Fight3: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Let's go! Climb out the window and beat that corpse back to death! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Hold %1 to climb through the window!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Fight3Bis: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> That was INCORRECT. <LINE> <LINE> Do NOT break with the cycle. To open or close a window you tap "%1 = "", To climb through you HOLD "%1 = "", <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Tap "%1" to reopen the window, before we consider termination.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Fight4: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> She hasn't seen us! <LINE> <LINE> Holding the Right Mouse Button will ready your weapon for an attack. An Isometric Cursor is shown to help you gauge your angle of approach! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Hold the Right Mouse Button!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Fight5: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Hold the Right Mouse Button and move using %1 to strafe up close to the fetid hat woman! <LINE> <LINE> Click the Left Mouse Button to attack when ready! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Remember: hold the Right Mouse Button to ready the Frying Pan, then left click to swing!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Fight7: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Take that Mom! <LINE> <LINE> You could also have pressed %1 to shove her, but right now we need to go for the head! <LINE> <LINE> The Isometric Cursor is VITAL to this.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Fight7B: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> The Isometric Cursor shows your mouse's position in relation to the floor. <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Line yourself up using the Right Mouse Button, and use the circle at the bottom of the Isometric Cursor to target the head! Bash with Left Mouse Button when you're in place!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Fight8New: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> The Frying Pan broke! Your mother's skull was really thick! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Let's borrow the Hunting Knife we planted in her back earlier! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Loot and equip the Hunting Knife from mother's body! Right click the Hunting Knife in the Loot Panel to show Equip options!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Sneak1: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> You hear that? There's more! <LINE> <LINE> Move up to the gate in the tall fence! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Press %1 to open the gate, or click on it with Left Mouse Button when you're close!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Sneak1Bis: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Vegetative shambler in the vegetable garden! But he's got enough brain function to see you! <LINE> <LINE> If you sneak you'll make less noise, and you'll be less visible. <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Press %1 to toggle crouch, and then move to sneak!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Sneak2: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Wow! It's like you're invisible! I mean, we've maxxed out your skills here - but that IS impressive. <LINE> <LINE> If you sneak close to a wall, fence or vehicle you'll crouch lower and reduce your visibility even MORE. <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Sneak round the corner to the low gate in the fence!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Sneak2Bis: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Do as we request. This is wasting time and money. <LINE> <LINE> Press %1 to crouch. Stay near the fence to automatically crouch lower. <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Sneak to the gate in the fence. Now.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Sneak3: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> So silent, and so deadly! Like a doomed ninja! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Stay crouched and open the gate with %1, or click it with the Left Mouse Button when close!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Sneak4: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> This is some Special Forces stuff right here! <LINE> <LINE> Strafe close behind him with the knife! Your arm will raise to show you're in place for a stealth attack! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Strafe by holding Right Mouse Button, attack with a left click when directly behind! Get close!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Sneak4Bis: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Good effort, but you need to get closer! When you're in range your left arm will raise! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Strafe close by holding Right Mouse Button, and attack with a left click when directly behind!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Sneak5: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> You did it! No more Daddy issues! <LINE> <LINE> Now take his bag, and put it on! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Make sure you're standing over the corpse, and right click the Large Backpack in the Loot Panel to show interaction options.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Sneak6: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> You've wanted this Large Backpack for years, and now it's yours! <LINE> <LINE> Let's see what's inside! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Find the flashing Large Backpack icon to the side of the Inventory Panel. Click on it!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Sneak7: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> A loaded shotgun and some bandages! <LINE> We always do our best for you. Equip it in both hands! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Right click the shotgun to show interaction options.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Bandage1: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> The window in Dad's shed just broke, right on time! <LINE> Vault the fence, and let's check it out! Running at the fence will make you jump over it automatically. <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Run using %1 and %2 towards the fence!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Bandage2: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Dad was a prepper, but he didn't prepare for you did he? <LINE> <LINE> Let's take his gear! Ignore the glass shards! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Climb through the broken window by standing next to it and holding %1.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Bandage2Bis: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> INSOLENCE! That was NOT the fence we told you to vault! <LINE> <LINE> We will carry on regardless. There is a broken window in the shed beyond the vegetable garden. <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Climb through by holding %1.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Bandage3: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Oh no! Your hands are bleeding! The broken glass in the window shredded them. Who saw that coming? <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Open the Health Panel by pressing %1, or clicking the Heart Icon.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Bandage4: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> The bandages from the backpack will help! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Right click the red text that's reporting the hurty left hand, and apply a bandage.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Bandage5: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Let's check outside, in case there's more mouldering flesh automatons! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Move to the curtained window!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Bandage6: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Curtains stop you seeing out, but they also stop the horde seeing in! <LINE> <LINE> Open the curtain, it's probably safe. <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Right Mouse Button to interact, or hold Left Shift and left click the curtain!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Bandage7: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Two of them! <LINE> Three if you count your sister on the floor there! <LINE> <LINE> Better get some improved protection from their nails and teeth!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Bandage8: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Thicker clothing and headwear helps protect from bites and scratches. <LINE> <LINE> Put on what you think is best for a final encounter! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Once you're ready, head through the door!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Shotgun1: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Remember that you can sneak to make less noise. <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Press %1 to crouch, and move up to the wired fence.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Shotgun1b: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> If you have high enough skills, and aren't exhausted, then tall fences can be climbed! <LINE> <LINE> You have those skills! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Press %1 to climb over the wire fence!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Shotgun2: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> So athletic! Time to make some noise! <LINE> <LINE> Ready the shotgun! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Aim at the rotting dead men by holding the Right Mouse Button!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Shotgun3: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Here they come! <LINE> <LINE> A red circle will show when you're aiming at a target! <RGB:1,1,1> <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Press the Left Mouse Button to fire while you're aiming with the Right Mouse Button!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Shotgun4: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> They're all dead! So sad! <LINE> <LINE> Never mind, soon you'll all be back together! <LINE> <LINE> Every zombie in the forest heard the shotgun, and they're coming for you! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Press %1 to climb back over the wire fence and escape!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Shotgun5: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> They're getting closer! <LINE> <LINE> You know how to run, but here's how to SPRINT! Sprint to the marker by the outhouse! Now! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Press %1 to move and %2 to toggle sprint!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Shotgun5a: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> They're getting closer! <LINE> <LINE> You know how to run, but here's how to SPRINT! Sprint to the marker by the outhouse! Now! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Press %1 to move and double-tap %2 to toggle sprint!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Shotgun6: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Last advice! If you ever get a zombie bite, or fear one is imminent, then press "%1" and you'll swallow the antidote! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Press %1 to take the antidote!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Shotgun7: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Only kidding! <LINE> <LINE> All hope is gone. There is no antidote. <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Have fun!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Shotgun8: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> You died! <LINE> <LINE> For further help in the main game press %1 to open the Survival Guide. <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Return to the Main Menu, and then survive the Knox Event for real!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Welcome2Joypad: <SIZE:medium> First things first: you can zoom!. <LINE> <JOYPAD:Back,28,28> Will bring a menu with various things. <LINE> <LINE> Let's get a bird's eye view of the lonely place where you're about to die - miserable and alone! <LINE> <SIZE:large> Hold <JOYPAD:Back,28,28> then select <IMAGE:media/ui/ZoomOut.png,28,28> with <JOYPAD:Aiming,28,28> , finally release <JOYPAD:Back,28,28>.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Welcome3Joypad: <SIZE:medium> First things first: <JOYPAD:Back,28,28> will lead you to many exciting departments! <LINE> <LINE> Let's have a look at your survivor's character information! <LINE> <SIZE:large> Hold <JOYPAD:Back,28,28> then select <IMAGE:media/ui/Heart2_On.png,32,32> with <JOYPAD:Aiming,28,28>. Release <JOYPAD:Back,28,28> and you're there! <LINE>
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Welcome5Joypad: <SIZE:medium> Do you know another good panel? Yes! The Skills Panel! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Press <JOYPAD:CycleTabsLeft,28,28> to cycle through panels, and check on your skills!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Welcome8Joypad: <SIZE:medium> Time to take off those training wheels, lady! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:medium> Close the Character Panel by pressing <JOYPAD:ClosePanel,28,28> and we'll move onto the next exciting aspect of survivor life!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Welcome9Joypad: <SIZE:medium> It's... looking at stuff! Woo! <LINE> <LINE> By moving <JOYPAD:Aiming,28,28> you'll turn to face ANY angle! <LINE> <LINE> Try it now!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Welcome2bisJoy: <SIZE:medium> Now, zoom back in again. <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Open back the menu with <JOYPAD:Back,28,28>, but this time select <IMAGE:media/ui/ZoomIn.png,32,32> <LINE>
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_WalkTo1Joypad: <SIZE:medium> Let's get some blood pumping, before it congeals and rots! <LINE> <LINE> Walk and move with <JOYPAD:Movement,28,28>. <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Why not go into the adjacent room? It's definitely safe!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_WalkTo2Joypad: <SIZE:medium> See! Told you it was safe! Now, let's strafe! <LINE> <LINE> Holding <JOYPAD:Aiming,28,28> will let you look around while walking. This will help you line up attacks and watch your back. <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Strafe towards the piano by holding <JOYPAD:Aiming,28,28> and moving using <JOYPAD:Movement,28,28>.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_InvLoot1Joypad: <SIZE:medium> Pressing <JOYPAD:Inventory,28,28> will open your Inventory and the Looting Panel! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Do it now! Press <JOYPAD:Inventory,28,28> !
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_InvLoot2Joypad: <SIZE:medium> See those blinking containers on the far right of the Looting Panel? They are all the containers you can loot nearby. <LINE> <LINE> Press <JOYPAD:CycleLoot,28,28> to cycle through the containers!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_InvLoot3Joypad: <SIZE:large> A dead rat! <SIZE:medium> <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> To pick it up, press <JOYPAD:TransferItem,28,28>.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_InvLoot4Joypad: <SIZE:medium> We should probably pick up that Empty Jar too. Dying of thirst is horrid. <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Press <JOYPAD:TransferItem,28,28> to loot it!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_InvUse1Joypad: <SIZE:medium> See those Moodles to the right? <LINE> Looks like someone's got a rumbly tummy! Time to eat! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> First, press <JOYPAD:DPadLeft,28,28> to select your inventory!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_InvUse1BisJoyp: <SIZE:medium> Perfect, press <JOYPAD:Interact,28,28> on the dead rat in your inventory to see interaction options! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Select Eat, then All and press <JOYPAD:Interact,28,28> to eat the dead rat!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_InvUse2Joypad: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> That's better! Apart from the nausea...
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_InvUse2BisJoyp: <SIZE:medium> Oh hey, better fill up your jar before the water supply is cut off. <LINE> <LINE> Pressing <JOYPAD:InteractOptions,28,28> near a world item will bring up interaction options! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Move next to the sink and press <JOYPAD:InteractOptions,28,28> then select Fill Empty Jar and confirm with <JOYPAD:Interact,28,28>.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_InvUse3Joypad: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> You automatically drink from water that's carried in your main inventory. <LINE> <LINE> Let's see what's in the other cupboards! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Let's get to that flashy container!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_InvUse3BisJoyp: <SIZE:medium> Now press <JOYPAD:Inventory,28,28> to open your Loot Panel.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_InvUse4Joypad: <SIZE:medium> You can look in nearby containers by walking close to them <LINE> Every container within reach can be opened with <JOYPAD:CycleLoot,28,28> <LINE> <LINE> Conveniently enough, there's a weapon hidden for you nearby! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Loot the surrounding containers to find a weapon!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_InvUse5Joypad: <SIZE:medium> Well, it's near enough a weapon! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Press <JOYPAD:Interact,28,28> on the Frying Pan and select 'Equip Primary' so you can use it on all the dead folk you meet!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Fight2Joypad: <SIZE:medium> A zombie in a hat! <LINE> <LINE> Let's get out there! Pressing <JOYPAD:Interact,28,28> will interact with objects in front of you. Most notably: doors and windows! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Press <JOYPAD:Interact,28,28> to open the window!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Fight3Joypad: <SIZE:medium> Let's go! Climb out the window and beat that corpse back to death! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Press <JOYPAD:ClimbThrough,28,28> to climb through the window!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Fight3BisJoypa: <SIZE:medium> That was INCORRECT. <LINE> <LINE> Do NOT break with the cycle. To open or close a window you press <JOYPAD:Interact,28,28> . To climb through you press <JOYPAD:ClimbThrough,28,28>, or press and hold <JOYPAD:Interact>. <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Press <JOYPAD:Interact,28,28> to reopen the window, before we consider termination.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Fight4Joypad: <SIZE:medium> She hasn't seen us! <LINE> <LINE> Pushing <JOYPAD:Aiming,28,28> in any direction will ready your weapon for an attack. <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Push <JOYPAD:Aiming,28,28> !
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Fight5Joypad: <SIZE:medium> Push <JOYPAD:Aiming,28,28> toward the zombie, and move using <JOYPAD:Movement,28,28> to strafe up close! <LINE> <LINE> Press <JOYPAD:Attack,28,28> to attack when ready!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Fight7Joypad: <SIZE:medium> Take that Mom! <LINE> <LINE> You could also have pressed <JOYPAD:Melee,28,28> to shove her over, but right now we need to go for the head! <LINE> <LINE> Line yourself up using <JOYPAD:Movement,28,28> and <JOYPAD:Aiming,28,28> and bash her using <JOYPAD:Attack,28,28>.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Fight8NewJoypa: <SIZE:medium> The Frying Pan broke! Your mother's skull was really thick! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:medium> Let's borrow the Hunting Knife we planted in her back earlier! Equip it as a Primary Weapon! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Open the Loot Panel using <JOYPAD:Inventory,28,28> , then select Hunting Knife and press <JOYPAD:Interact,28,28> to show Equip options!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Sneak1Joypad: <SIZE:medium> You hear that? There's more! <LINE> <LINE> Move up to the gate in the tall fence! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Press <JOYPAD:Interact,28,28> to open the gate when you're close!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Sneak1BisJoypa: <SIZE:medium> Vegetative shambler in the vegetable garden! But he's got enough brain function to see you! <LINE> <LINE> If you sneak you'll make less noise, and you'll be less visible. <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Push down on <JOYPAD:Movement,28,28> to toggle crouch, and then move to sneak!
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Sneak2BisJoypa: <SIZE:medium> Do as we request. This is wasting time and money. <LINE> <LINE> Push down on <JOYPAD:Movement,28,28> to crouch. Stay near the fence to automatically crouch lower. <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Sneak to the gate in the fence. Now.

values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Tutorial1_Sneak5Joypad: <SIZE:medium> You did it! No more Daddy issues! Now take his bag, and put it on! <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:large> Stand over the corpse, press <JOYPAD:Inventory,28,28> to loot and press <JOYPAD:Interact,28,28> on the Large Backpack. Then equip!

values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_DesignationZone_WanderIn: Animals will not leave their designated Zone as long as it's safe.
They will leave if too stressed, thirsty, or if zombies are near.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_AnimalUI_Info: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Animal Info <LINE> <LINE> <LEFT> <SIZE:small> Animals need a Livestock Zone, created using the "designation" icon on the left. Any zones that touch form a bigger zone. More detailed information can be found on the Zone info panel, and in the Survival Guide. <LINE> <LINE> Build a trough using the Carpentry menu. The trough has to be in the animal's designation zone to work properly. <LINE> More detailed information can be found on the trough info panel. <LINE> <LINE> Add food by placing it in the trough's container. <LINE> Add water in the trough by right clicking it. <LINE> <LINE> Animals get stressed by loud noises, being near zombies, and by people running near them. <LINE> <LINE> Males usually attack each other during their mating season. <LINE> Babies that need milk need access to their mothers.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_AnimalUI_Info_cow: <LINE> <LINE> Cow: <LINE> Calves need milk from their mother. <LINE> Mating season is all year round. <LINE> Cows start to produce milk a few days after becoming pregnant. <LINE> You can milk a cow with a bucket. <LINE> When the pregnancy is over, if not milked or the calf does not feed from its mother, the cow will stop producing milk after few days. <LINE> Can eat Hay, Grass, Vegetables, Fruits, and Animal Feed.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_AnimalUI_Info_bull: <LINE> <LINE> Bull: <LINE> Calves need milk from their mother. <LINE> Mating season is all year round. <LINE> From adolescence, bulls will fight other bulls. <LINE> Can eat Hay, Grass, Vegetables, Fruits, and Animal Feed.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_AnimalUI_Info_pig: <LINE> <LINE> Pig: <LINE> Piglets need milk from their mother. <LINE> Their mating season is September to February. <LINE> Sows start to produce milk a few days after becoming pregnant. <LINE> When the pregnancy is over, if not milked or a piglet doesn't feed from the sow, the sow will stop producing milk after a few days. <LINE> Can eat Hay, Grass, Vegetables, Fruits, and Animal Feed.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_AnimalUI_Info_boar: <LINE> <LINE> Boar: <LINE> Piglets need milk from their mother. <LINE> Their mating season is September to February. <LINE> Males don't fight each other. <LINE> Can eat Hay, Grass, Vegetables, Fruits, and Animal Feed.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_AnimalUI_Info_ewe: <LINE> <LINE> Ewe: <LINE> Lambs need milk from their mother. <LINE> Mating season is September to February. <LINE> Ewes start to produce milk a few days after becoming pregnant. <LINE> You can milk a sheep with a bucket. <LINE> When the pregnancy is over, if not milked or a lamb doesn't feed from the ewe, the ewe will stop producing milk after a few days. <LINE> The ewe starts producing wool from adolescence. <LINE> You can shear an animal that has enough wool with a Shears. <LINE> Can eat Hay, Grass, Vegetables, Fruits, and Animal Feed.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_AnimalUI_Info_ram: <LINE> <LINE> Ram: <LINE> Lambs need milk from their mother. <LINE> Mating season is September to February. <LINE> From adolescence, rams will fight other rams. <LINE> Rams start producing wool from adolescence. <LINE> You can shear an animal that has enough wool with a Shears. <LINE> Can eat Hay, Grass, Vegetables, Fruits, and Animal Feed.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_AnimalUI_Info_hen: <LINE> <LINE> Hen: <LINE> Hens will go into a hutch at night. Animals inside a closed hutch will be protected from predators. <LINE> Animals will leave the hutch in the morning. <LINE> Chicken lays one egg per day. <LINE> Only a hen that has been fertilized by a cockerel will lay eggs that will hatch. <LINE> Mating season is all year round. <LINE> Can eat Hay, Grass, Vegetables, Fruits, Seeds, Nuts, and Animal Feed.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_AnimalUI_Info_cockerel: <LINE> <LINE> Cockerel: <LINE> Cockerels will go into a hutch at night. Animals inside closed hutch will be protected from predators. <LINE> Animals will leave the hutch in the morning. <LINE> Only a hen that has been fertilized by a cockerel can lay eggs that will hatch. <LINE> Mating season is all year round. <LINE> From adolescence, cockerels will fight other cockerels. <LINE> Can eat Hay, Grass, Vegetables, Fruits, Seeds, Nuts, and Animal Feed.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Hutch_Info: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Hutch <LINE> <LINE> <LEFT> <SIZE:small> Chickens will go inside the hutch from night until morning if the doors are opened to allow them to do so. Close the doors once all animals are inside to protect them from predators. <LINE> <LINE> Hutches get dirty over time, and get dirtier quicker with more animals inside. Clean a hutch with Water and a Mop or Towel. A dirty hutch will have a negative impact on its occupants' health. <LINE> <LINE> Hens will lay eggs in the nest boxes inside hutches. If the boxes are full, hens will lay eggs outside.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_Trough_Info: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Trough <LINE> <LINE> <LEFT> <SIZE:small> To add food to a trough, place it inside the trough's container. <LINE> To add water, right click the trough, and select "Add Water = "", <LINE> Troughs can only contain food or water, not both. <LINE> <LINE> A trough needs to be placed in a Designation Zone so your animals can find it.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_AnimalTrailer_Info: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Animal Trailer <LINE> <LINE> <LEFT> <SIZE:small> To put an animal inside a trailer, bring it near the rear door and right click the trailer. <LINE> You can also do so with a small animal you are carrying. <LINE> <LINE> The animals can eat from the food container inside a trailer. <LINE> You can also directly feed or give water to an animal inside a trailer by right clicking on the trailer. <LINE> Trailers have a nest box, which chickens will lay eggs inside. <LINE> Each trailer has a total capacity, with each animal adding to this capacity depending on their type and size. <LINE> Animals in trailers will slowly gain stress when the trailer is moving.
values.IG_UI.json|IGUI_DesignationZone_Info: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Livestock Zones <LINE> <LINE> <LEFT> <SIZE:small> An animal needs to be inside a Livestock Zone to stop it from wandering away. <LINE> Click on the Zoning icon in the upper left, click "Add Zone", then drag a rectangle to create a new Zone. Zones that touch will be considered as a single Zone by the animal. <LINE> <LINE> Animals will tend to stay in their designated Zone, but will flee if stressed. To avoid that build an enclosure around the Zone. <LINE> <LINE> Right click on any of a Zone's squares and select "Check Zone" to see its current animals, hutches, food, and other information. <LINE> <LINE> Animals will also recognize roofed areas in their Zone and tend to stay under them during rain.

values.March Ridge, KY.json|description: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> MARCH RIDGE <LINE> <LINE><LEFT> <SIZE:small>  At-tent-ion! March Ridge serves as the home of many of Fort Knox's brave soldiers and their families. <LINE> <LINE> Despite its structured layout and secured access, March Ridge has plenty of opportunities for "R and R". <LINE> <LINE> Rent your favorite flick at Hit Vids. Catch the latest blockbusters at the Star-E-Plex. <LINE>  <LINE> You can even take a tour of the abandoned Cold War nuclear bunker - and be thankful the apocalypse never happened!
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl1: Hard to run or swing a weapon. Why not have a rest in a comfy chair?
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl2: Can barely jog or swing a weapon.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl3: Can barely walk or swing a weapon.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Endurance_desc_lvl4: Can barely move or swing a weapon.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Stress_desc_lvl3: Shaking hands. Impossible to think straight. Make it stop!
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Stress_desc_lvl4: You're at your limit! This can't go on...
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Tired_desc_lvl2: It's well past your bedtime. Growing weak with tiredness.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Tired_desc_lvl3: Can barely think straight. Weak with tiredness.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Tired_desc_lvl4: So weak and tired. Desperately, inhumanly tired.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Hungry_desc_lvl1: Could do with a bite to eat.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Hungry_desc_lvl2: Could eat a horse right now. Growing weaker.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Hungry_desc_lvl4: Just a crumb, a berry, a cockroach, anything...
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Panic_desc_lvl1: Do your best to remain calm.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Sick_desc_lvl4: Increasing danger of becoming rat food.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Bored_desc_lvl2: Why does nothing interesting ever happen around here?
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Bored_desc_lvl3: Can barely take it any more. Isn't there ANYTHING fun to do?
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Bored_desc_lvl4: They never said the end of the world would be like this...
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl1: Having a hard time lately. Seek some way to forget your troubles.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl2: You always feel on the edge of tears. Nothing seems to go your way.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl3: Ravaged by mourning and desperation. You're losing hope...
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Unhappy_desc_lvl4: What's the point in going on? Nothing good will ever happen...
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Wet_desc_lvl1: Slightly damp from rain, sweat, or something else...
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Wet_desc_lvl2: Damp from rain, sweat, or something else...
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Wet_desc_lvl4: You're going to catch a cold!
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_HasACold_desc_lvl3: Sneezing and coughing. You feel sick and slow.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_HasACold_desc_lvl4: Continually coughing and sneezing. You'd better look after yourself.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Injured_desc_lvl3: Severely weakened by injuries or illness.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Injured_desc_lvl4: Not going gently into that good night...
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Pain_desc_lvl2: Throbbing pain. It's hard to keep focused.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Pain_desc_lvl3: The pain brings tears to your eyes. It's hard to go on.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Pain_desc_lvl4: Searing pain shoots through your body. It's hard to even think.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_HeavyLoad_desc_lvl2: Carrying too much. You're slowed by the weight.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_HeavyLoad_desc_lvl3: Carrying far too much. You can barely move.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_HeavyLoad_desc_lvl4: Can't take much more! You're going to hurt yourself carrying all that.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Drunk_desc_lvl2: Had one too many. Co-ordination slightly impaired.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Drunk_desc_lvl3: Had a few too many. Co-ordination impaired.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Drunk_desc_lvl4: 'Iss you an' me 'gainst the wurld. I love you. I LOVE YOU.'
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Dead_desc_lvl4: This is how you died. High risk of becoming rat food.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Zombie_desc_lvl4: Sudden attraction to gunshots, house alarms, and human flesh.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl1: Gnawing hunger entirely absent. For now.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl2: Tummy full. Goodness making its way through your system.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl3: Stomach contented. You feel healthier and stronger.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_FoodEaten_desc_lvl4: Couldn't manage another single, solitary bite.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Hyperthermia_desc_l: Consider wearing less clothing. You feel thirstier.
Nauseous, unable to concentrate, and desperate for liquids.
Delirious. The heat is melting your life away. Get somewhere colder!
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Hypothermia_desc_lv: It feels a bit nippy round here...
You need to find ways to keep warm.
Man alive, it is SO cold.
You're going out. You may be some time.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Windchill_desc_lvl1: The wind's making it feel a little colder.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Windchill_desc_lvl2: The wind's making it feel somewhat colder.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Windchill_desc_lvl3: The wind's making it feel a lot colder.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Windchill_desc_lvl4: The wind feels like you're being stabbed with icicles.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_CantSprint_desc_lvl: Heavy clothing, bulky bags, or large items are making you unable to sprint.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_Uncomfortable_desc_: Your clothes, the environment, or something else is making you uncomfortable and unhappy.
Your clothes, the environment, or something else is making you very uncomfortable and unhappy.
Your clothes, the environment, or something else is making you extremely uncomfortable and unhappy.
values.Moodles.json|Moodles_NoxiousSmell_desc_l: A vile stink makes you feel ill.
You can't breathe. Get away from here!

values.Muldraugh, KY.json|description: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> MULDRAUGH - NEW AND IMPROVED <LINE> <LINE><LEFT> <SIZE:small> Muldraugh grew as an Army town, but now welcomes folks from all walks of life: commuters to bigger towns like West Point and Rosewood, military families, and some living below the poverty line. <LINE> <LINE>Despite its small size Muldraugh boasts a sizable motel, a recently expanded primary school, a huge lumberyard, and the finest Spiffo burgers this side of Kentucky! Sure, not much happens here, but that doesn't mean Muldraugh life is dull...

scaleY:0.4, autoWidth:247/0.4, textLeading:3, font:UIFont.SdfOldRegular>FRANKFORT - Governor Cal Fairweather has reassured Brandenburg's mayor that the long-promised federal funds for the rebuild- ing of Brandenburg are "on the way."                Despite an overwhelming early response following the tornado on April 18, which saw ample aid provided for residents in the aftermath, promised federal funds for re- building have still not arrived, with buildings patched up with wood, and major damage still evident.                                                      Early warnings meant many residents were taking shelter when the tornado touched down in the northeast part of town, but the high winds killed three residents and injured dozens. The F2 tornado destroyed cars and razed houses. Hundreds of people remain homeless, living in hotels or trailer parks paid for by the state, with others living with relatives or friends. Up to 40% of residences and 30% of businesses in the area are uninsured, meaning the cost to the taxpayer could exceed 50 million dollars.           Kentucky is often struck by tornadoes, but the April whirlwind took authorities  by ^(continued p.2)<type:text, x:305, y:640, r:0, g:0, b:0, a:0.9, pivotX:0, pivotY:0, scaleX:0.8, scaleY:0.8, textLeading:-4, font:UIFont.SdfOldBold>Hunter injured in^deer attack<type:text, x:305, y:700, r:0, g:0, b:0, a:0.9, scaleX:0.4, scaleY:0.4, autoWidth:217/0.4, textLeading:3, font:UIFont.SdfOldRegular>RIVERSIDE - John Nathan, a hunter from New York, has said he was lucky to not have been severely injured after a run-in with a stag in the forest west of Riverside. Police in the French capital made two arrests on Monday following a months long investigation into a daring heist at one of Paris's most exclusive hotels.                                 Marie-Christine Lacour and Claude Beaumarchais were charged with decep- tion, burglary, assault, drug possession, and grand larceny after police linked the pair to the theft at the Paris Havisham last October. The pair, who are famous social- ites, are being accused of infiltrating the Havisham hotel disguised as staff and abseiling down seven stories to the balcony of a room, where a prominent European royal was staying. Despite riots and unrest in major cities, the streets of Louisville, only a short distance from the Knox Exclusion Zone, are  qui- eter than ever. And yet, despite attempts by many residents to look on the bright side and downplay the threat, it's clear many feel a gnawing anxiety about the Knox Virus.              Authorities are now saying that the virus, though deadly, spreads only through fluid contact, drawing comparisons to ebola outbreaks, which were eventually contained. But  there's  never  been an ebola outbreak so near to a major city, and some residents have already relocated over the Ohio River. Though the WHO lacks any legal authority to  enforce  the  advice, all flights were grounded almost immediately by airlines shocked at the sudden nature of the an- nouncement.                             In a White House briefing,  the  President has called the WHO's an- nouncement "unwelcome and economically un- sound".                                    Air Erin CEO Ryan Byrne  said,  "We  knew this was coming, but we thought  we'd  at  least have time to prepare. We have to  comply. BRANDENBURG DISASTER FUNDS ON THE WAY, SAYS GOVERNOR

[image] - Governor Cal Fairweather speaking in Frankfort yesterday.

FRANKFORT - Governor Cal Fairweather has reassured Brandenburg's mayor that the long-promised federal funds for the rebuilding of Brandenburg are "on the way."
 Despite an overwhelming early response following the tornado on April 18, which saw ample aid provided for residents in the aftermath, promised federal funds for rebuilding have still not arrived, with buildings patched up with wood, and major damage still evident.
 Early warnings meant many residents were taking shelter when the tornado touched down in the northeast part of town, but the high winds killed three residents and injured dozens. The F2 tornado destroyed cars and razed houses. Hundreds of people remain homeless, living in hotels or trailer parks paid for by the state, with others living with relatives or friends. Up to 40% of residences and 30% of businesses in the area are uninsured, meaning the cost to the taxpayer could exceed 50 million dollars.
 Kentucky is often struck by tornadoes, but the April whirlwind took authorities by... (continued p.2)

HUNTER INJURED IN DEER ATTACK

RIVERSIDE - John Nathan, a hunter from New York, has said he was lucky to not have been severely injured after a run-in with a stag in the forest west of Riverside. "I've been hunting in the Knox area for years," said Nathan, "but I never saw something like this, especially outside of rutting season. I was lining up a shot on a rabbit when a white-tail stag suddenly burst out of... (continued p.4)

EKRON'S OLDEST RESIDENT GIVES LONG LIFE SECRET

EKRON - Full of lively talk and old songs, it's hard to believe Nancy Hume, Ekron's oldest resident, is 103 years old. "I outlived all my friends," she says, then adds with a smile, "but I outlived all my enemies too!" So what are Nancy's secrets? "Bourbon with your supper, bed before 10, and never get involved with men. Never!"

Delilah in Brandenburg "indefinitely" - see page 2
Chapelmount Downs plans Virginia track - see page 4

WIDESPREAD TELEPHONE OUTAGES IN KNOX AREA

[image] - KT says its engineers are working "around the clock."

KNOX AREA - Knox Telecommunications has apologized for an hours-long outage on its networks which continues at the time of printing, leaving thousands of Knox residents without any access to telephone and Internet services.
 The unplanned outage has caused chaos, with several businesses which rely on telecommuting having to remain closed for the day, and others left unable to communicate with customers or suppliers. The cause of such a serious but localized outage has not been announced, but KT say they are "working on it" with dozens of engineers working on telephone poles throughout the area.
 One expert, Kevin Hogan, told Knox Knews, "this sort of failure is incredibly uncommon. It doesn't seem related to any single switchboard or central system. I've heard reports there are wires down or disconnected. Either they were all overloaded by a lightning strike, or this is the work of vandals or saboteurs." (continued p.2)

LOCALS COMPETE FOR MINT JULEP PRIZE

KNOX AREA - Many a Kentucky friendship has been irreparably destroyed by arguments about the perfect mint julep. And yet the Mint Julep Prize competition, held last Saturday in Brandenburg, was full of lighthearted chat and free and healthy debates about the state's favorite cocktail. The Best Traditional Julep award went to Casey Stockhome. Judges deemed her... (continued p.4)

IRVINGTON RESIDENT "LUCKY TO BE ALIVE"

IRVINGTON - Local resident Sally Graham has said she is lucky to be alive following a fiery car crash south of the city on Thursday. Sally crashed into a wall, setting the car on fire. Fast intervention from a passerby saved Graham's life. "He pulled me from the car and stopped the bleeding until the ambulance could arrive. It took such a long time, with the phone lines being... (continued p.3)

Two arrests in house repair scam investigation - see page 3
Ohio River more polluted than ever - see page 5

"OPERATION CENTAUR WINDING DOWN" - FBI

[image] - FBI Director Ian Clark speaking in Louisville.

LOUISVILLE -The FBI investigation into corruption in the Kentucky General Assembly, codenamed Operation Centaur, has now achieved its main objectives and is winding down, FBI Director Ian Clark said in a press conference in Louisville yesterday.
 The operation saw more than a dozen Kentucky legislators indicted and convicted of taking bribes related to toxic waste dumping, extortion, racketeering, and conspiracy to defraud the state of Kentucky. House Speaker Dan Dullford has already resigned after being charged with extortion, racketeering, and lying to the FBI.
 Governor Cal Fairweather was also caught in the controversy, and had to distance himself from two of his aides in February following their arrest for accepting bribes, "without the Governor's consent or knowledge."
 The controversy crosses party lines, with both Democrats and Republicans indicted. Other legislators facing trial include the... (continued p.2)

PHONE LINES STILL DOWN ACROSS AREA

KNOX AREA - Knox Telecommunications has apologized for a second day of telephone outages in the Knox region. Cell and car phone reception has also been affected, with both businesses and residences left in turmoil. KT has claimed the outages are due to "severe issues with a local telephone exchange", and warns it... (continued p.4)

WP RESIDENT DIES AFTER EATING 60 HOT DOGS

WEST POINT - The 16th Annual West Point Hot Dog Eating competition had a tragic end as the winner, Bolton Jupiter, passed away shortly after winning. "He held up the trophy," said an onlooker, "a little wiener with shades. Then he keeled over on a bucket of mayonnaise." (continued p.3)

Hot weather to continue next week - see page 2
Tim Johnson "likely out for season" - see page 4

"NO DANGER TO PUBLIC" AFTER CRASH, ARMY SAYS

[image] - The scene was sealed off and secured by military personnel.

MARCH RIDGE - A military truck carrying hazardous waste overturned just north of March Ridge at approximately 3:15 p.m. on Saturday. The contents of the truck are not being revealed to the public, but Col. Niall O'Malley has said, "the materials, though secret for operational reasons, would pose little danger even if they came into contact with the public, which they did not."
 Witnesses say the truck lost control on Route 60, south of the Farmer's Market, skidding onto the grass after narrowly missing a passing car, and overturned on the embankment. Officials did not deny the truck was overloaded.
 The incident is one of several involving hazardous materials in the Knox area. Environmental activists have criticized very "lax" standards, with toxic chemicals and compounds from poorly stored ammunition cited as the reason for higher than average rates of respiratory illnesses in the Knox area. State legislators recently repealed several environmental laws, a move which... (continued p.2)

SPEEDWAY COULD HOST FORMULA X

IRVINGTON - Formula X organizers have given a preliminary nod to Irvington Speedway as the host track of 1996's U.S. Grand Prix. Though the host track still remains in negotiation, officials are privately favoring the Speedway due to its location near Louisville, the track's innovative design and the openness of authorities to... (continued p.4)

HAPPY INDEPENDENCE DAY FROM KNOX KNEWS!

KNOX - It's been an honor to serve at Knox Knews for two consecutive July 4's. We hope our readers have a wonderful day as we remember why America was founded - and dream of what it could one day be.
All the very best,
Ian J. McCarrock
Editor-in-chief

"No end in sight" for Knox phone outages - see page 4
"Unusual illness" affects residents in Muldraugh - see page 6

EXCLUSIVE: KNOX HAS BEST INDEPENDENCE DAY EVER!

[image] - The Knox parade had its best attendance ever.

KNOX AREA - Despite disruptions of plans caused by the ongoing telephone outage in Knox, yesterday saw thousands of residents hold family barbecues, parties and fireworks as they celebrated America's 217th birthday together.
 An elaborate parade of twenty decorated floats passed through Knox on the way to Louisville, with local elementary school student Una Turner portraying Lady Liberty in the lead car, accompanied by brass bands from West Point, Riverside and Brandenburg playing patriotic tunes.
 A special event was held at the drag racing circuit near West Point, with world famous racing driver Cruz Dylan among the on-lookers - though the champion racer could not be persuaded to go for a drive himself, as he "didn't want to make the other racers look bad."
 In the evening, fireworks of red, white, and blue lit up the evening sky and glasses of lemonade and beer were raised to America, and to the memories of the many... (continued p.2)

FOUL SMELL COULD BE "NATURAL PROCESS"

OHIO RIVER - Joan Delahunt, a local geography teacher, has theorized that the foul smell in the Knox region is emanating from the Ohio River, and may be caused by an invading algae taking root in parts of the river.
 Delahunt noticed pieces of brown seaweed washed up on the river bank several several days ago. "It reminded... (continued p.2)

SPATE OF DOG ATTACKS "WORRISOME"

KNOX AREA - Sheriff John Carroll has reminded residents of their responsibility to keep their dogs under control, following a spate of attacks on farm animals and residents. "Dogs should never roam free," the sheriff said. "If they're at home, they should be fenced in, or kept indoors so they can't escape. If a dog bites someone, the dog... (continued p.3)

Murdered local "part of criminal gang" - see page 2
Debate on Irvington speed limits - see page 4

MYSTERY ILLNESS STRIKES LOCALS, OVERWHELMS AUTHORITIES

[image] - People have resorted to short-range radios to communicate with authorities. 

MULDRAUGH - An unidentified illness has struck dozens of residents in the Muldraugh region, with symptoms of severe fevers and vomiting. March Ridge has opened its military hospital to the public to help contain the illness, though it is not believed to spread person-to-person. Officials from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention are reportedly on the way to the hospital to aid in investigating the cause of the outbreak.
 It is understood that several of the afflicted have suffered bites, and Janine Cortman, a local doctor theorizes that a rabies out-break is in progress. Dr. Cortman said, "I treated four patients in the same day with the same symptoms. I'm out of rabies immunoglobin, so I'm extremely grateful the military has opened their hospital in Fort Knox to the public."
 Rabies was recently reported in the region among the wild animal population, but cases in humans are rare. "Before today," said Dr. Cortman, "I'd seen only three definite cases of rabies in humans. It's a worry that this... (continued p.2)

PHONE LINES STILL DOWN IN AREA

KNOX AREA - Knox Telecommunications has apologized to angry customers for an unscheduled maintenance period which has seen phone lines go down within the area for almost a week. The response to the Muldraugh illness outbreak has been hampered by the outage, with many seeking help using short range radio calls to police and medical authorities... (continued p.2)

SPIFFO'S "SORRY" AFTER SECRET SAUCE SHENANIGANS

RALEIGH, NC - Fast food chain Spiffo's has apologized after its Secret Sauce left local burger consumers with a bad taste in their mouths. Head of Logistics Paula Impton has said the mix-up occurred when a batch of new, experimental hot sauce was accidentally redirected to Kentucky in place of the... (continued p.3)

Dozens of cases reported in area
Response hampered by telephone outages

[image] - An ambulance at a house in the Muldraugh area, believed to be related to the outbreak.

Muldraugh, Ky. - Dozens of cases of a flu-like illness have been reported in the area of Muldraugh, a small town just north of Fort Knox, with symptoms including severe nausea and fever.
 With multiple military installations and toxic waste dumps in the area, doctors are looking at whether a chemical leak into the water supply or food chain may be responsible, though calls to outside authorities for assistance are reportedly being met with obfuscation and denials.
 The US Army has reportedly opened its quarantine facilities in its hospital in Fort Knox for use by... 

EXHIBITION DRAWS CROWD AT GALLERY
Artist's work very popular in Louisville

Louisville, Ky. - The Art Gallery of Louisville's new exhibition of paintings by Irish artist, Ashling Dwyer, drew large crowds Monday night.
 Dwyer, winner of the 1992 Siu-Chong Prize, unveiled a pair of new paintings, "Pink Curtain" and "Yellow, Yellow, Yellow". Both drew immediate applause and acclaim for their use of bold color, deeply emotive abstract patterns, and expert use of modern art techniques.
 Dwyer is part of a new wave of Irish artists making big waves internationally. Her other works include Chromatic Accident, and the live action piece, 48 Saucepans... 

BODY IDENTIFIED AS LOCAL ATTORNEY

Leaked photo raises questions
Officials move to dampen growing panic

[image] - The photograph, shown here censored for the dignity of the victims, shows a man with grievous injuries to one arm, standing in a street filled with bloodied bodies. 

Knox Event Zone, Ky. - The President, along with CDC and military officials, moved swiftly to reassure the public that the "Knox Virus" remains isolated within the Exclusion Zone after the leaking of a gruesome photo from within the Knox Event Zone yesterday.
 The photograph allegedly shows a person infected with the virus in a street full of bodies, causing panic among the public, and confusion about the seriousness of the virus.

"CURFEW NOT NEEDED" - LOUISVILLE MAYOR
Mayor downplays rumors after picture leak panic

Louisville - Mayor Terence Stahl dismissed rumors that Louisville will implement a voluntary curfew, in response to multiple other cities doing so.
 'Let those coastal elites panic,' said Mayor Stahl at a press conference on Monday. "Louisvillians are made of stronger stuff. We don't know anything about this illness, or virus, or whatever it is. The authorities are fully in control. Fear will hurt us far more than any outbreak can. It's, frankly, pretty disgusting, to suggest curfews do anything but make a tense situation a lot worse. Not to mention the financial impact on the economy, if local bars, businesses and restau-...

KNOX ZONE NOT BEING SUPPLIED

EARTHQUAKE STRIKES HOKKAIDO, JAPAN

"NO NEED FOR PANIC" - GEN. MCGREW
Virus lethal but "contained"
President leaves capital - "unrelated to outbreak"

[image] - Gen. John McGrew claimed "there is no need for further panic" amidst growing concern about the "Knox Virus's" lethality and infection rate.

Knox Event Zone - Gen. John McGrew released a statement on Tuesday admitting that the "Knox Virus" is degenerative, but claiming that its spread is contained within the Event Boundary which now encompasses hundreds of square miles of the state of Kentucky.
 The CDC has released a statement saying that though the virus seems to cause great violence between sufferers, its method of transmission through fluid contact is an inefficient way of spreading.
 Officials have also denied that the President has left Washington, D.C., due to the virus, saying his absence concerns a private family...

VATICAN CITY, MECCA, CLOSE TO PILGRIMS
Two major religious sites closed due to virus fears

Vatican City, the seat of the Roman Catholic Pope, and Mecca, the holiest city in Islam, are closing their doors to the outside world due to the threat of the "Knox Virus."
 The Pontiff has asked for "forgiveness and prayers" as the fortified city, located in the center of Rome, closed its doors to the public. The Swiss Guard has said it is "prepared for the worst" as thousands of pilgrims, already stranded due to the international grounding of flights, will be forced to limit their movements under new restrictions in the Italian capital.
 Saudi Arabia, which closed its borders indefinitely yesterday, has also announced that the city of...

DEMS JOIN GOP PRESIDENT CRITICS

LOUISVILLE MAYOR: "WE REMAIN OPEN"

KNOX BOUNDARY BREACHED
Gunfire and casualties reported at Knox border
Dozens dead, Army retreats

[image] - Hundreds people with the "Knox Virus" mindlessly attacked personnel and barricades with their hands, overwhelming military and civilians alike.

Knox Event Zone - Dozens of people have been killed as the military boundary south of Louisville has been breached by a crowd of hundreds of people infected with the "Knox Virus".
 Despite a shoot-to-kill policy put into place by authorities, the military was swiftly overwhelmed, and infected people attacked survivors living in tents in the Boundary Camp.
 The Knox Boundary Line is moving north towards Louisville as the military pulls back. Communications are sparse as networks struggle with overwhelming demand from civilians trying to...

STATES DEBATE KNOX SOLUTIONS
Authorities considering "radical solutions"

The Tennessee legislature voted to provide free firearms for all "steady-minded" residents. The California Supreme Court is moving to Santa Catalina Island. Both Houses of Congress have limited their attendance to 25%. These are just some of the strange scenes as authorities debate what to do about the Knox Virus.
 The debates centered on two topics: how to deal with the infected, and where safe zones could be set up to protect uninfected citizens. Suggestions ranged from quarantine to summary execution of the infected.
 Reports following the Knox boundary breach suggest that the... 

EVENT CANCELLATIONS "UP TO ORGANIZERS"

GOVERNOR ACCEPTS FEDERAL AID NEED

KNOX VIRUS SPREADS THROUGH AIR
Despair grips nation, world
Handful Immune to 'Aerial Strain'

[image] - A group of infected photographed by one of our team on the way to our offices on Thursday, near downtown Louisville. They were able to pass by safely.

The CDC has confirmed that the Knox Virus spreads rapidly through the air, although a small percentage of people are immune to the "aerial variant" of the virus. For everyone else, the likelihood of a cure or treatment is now close to zero. Help your elderly and vulnerable neighbors. Share food if you have more than you need. Avoid crowds at all costs.
 As we saw at the boundary, gunfire attracts them. Have a baseball bat or other easy-to-use weapon ready and don't be afraid to attack them. Once they die and come back, they only want to spread the virus.

A SPECIAL MESSAGE FROM THE HERALD

This is likely the Kentucky Herald's final edition. The virus is in Louisville. Several of us here are running fevers, and there are hundreds of infected in the streets.

 May God have mercy on the rest of us and our loved ones.

CONGRESS EVACUATES TO MOUNT WEATHER

VIRUS LIKELY "ALREADY GLOBAL"

IRAQ MAY STOP DEALING WITH UN
By Molly Aoide
Staff Writer

[image] - The Iraqi president speaking to international media in Baghdad.

BAGHDAD, Iraq - In a press conference on Monday, the Iraqi president said that the country may stop cooperating with the United Nations on the destruction of non-conventional weapons if a stand-off over missile site monitoring is not quickly resolved.
 "The Americans think we are weak," said the president from his palace. "We have weapons of such awesome power that they would cry like dogs were they even to learn of them. And yet, we are willing to give up such things, and pursue a path of peace, if we are dealt with fairly." A spokesman for the US president refused to comment on speculation that the president's cancellation of his attendance at the G7 meetings in Tokyo, scheduled to begin on Wednesday, were related to the Iraqi announcement.
 The other six G7 member countries - Japan, Canada, France, Italy, Germany, and the UK, along with the European Community - are expected to discuss a range of international issues, including aid for further business privatizations in Russia, nuclear weapons in the former Soviet Union and North Korea, and the deteriorating situation in the area formerly known as Yugoslavia. This G7 meeting, the 19th, will be the first for President...
(See "Iraq," A10)

TWO ARRESTS FOR 'DARING' PARISIAN GEM HEIST
By Jeff Franks
Staff Writer

PARIS, France - Police in the French capital made two arrests on Monday following a months long investigation into a daring heist at one of Paris's most exclusive hotels.
 Marie-Christine Lacour and Claude Beaumarchais were charged with deception, burglary, assault, drug possession, and grand larceny after police linked the pair to the theft at the Paris Havisham last October. The pair, who are famous socialites, are being accused of infiltrating the Havisham hotel disguised as staff and abseiling down seven stories to the balcony of a room, where a prominent European royal was staying. They drilled a hole in the room's window...
(See "Heist," A12)

BLOCKADE IN KENTUCKY
By Jeff Franks
Staff Writer

values.Print_Text.json|Print_Text_Coalfield_inf:
Coalfield, Kentucky

A Taste of the Wild West

Founded in the 1850s as a stop for travelers heading east, Coalfield became notorious for a series of conflicts between Sheriff Everett Holloway and Irvin Bradshaw and his gang.
The feud culminated with a massive shootout on the night of August 11, 1882, which ended when the Lawman's Distillery caught fire and exploded, taking many buildings with it. No sign of Everett Holloway or Irvin Bradshaw was ever found.

Now you can visit the original site of Coalfield, renovated accurately. Visit our general store, have a drink in the saloons, experience life as a blacksmith, tour period cabins, and see what the Old West was really like!

Come along every Saturday for a reenactment of the shootout between Holloway's lawmen and the Bradshaw gang!

values.Print_Text.json|Print_Text_ColdWarBunker:
Tour a Future that didn't happen!

Just off Adams Road in northern March Ridge sits a fenced area with a small shed and a radio tower.

For decades, this was the entrance to a top secret nuclear bunker, built to house Fort Knox's military leaders.

Built four storeys underground in 1960, with thick steel doors, the bunker was made to withstand a direct nuclear hit on Fort Knox itself.

Space was limited, with beds for only forty people. It's unlikely the bunker would have survived for long without resupply.

Thankfully, armageddon did not arrive.

The bunker was decommissioned in 1991 and is now available for weekend tours!

Book ahead on 943-555-7843.

Note: Tour not suitable for the claustrophobic or young children. Bunker has not been fully checked for asbestos and some forms of poisoning. Waivers must be signed on entry.

values.RadioData.json|RD_2d525d27-d419-48fa-b4b: ... modern artist and winner of the 1992 Siu-Chong Prize.
values.RadioData.json|RD_4a0821de-a6c4-4e90-86d: Now, you started off with abstract paintings...

values.RadioData.json|RD_14a3e0b1-8d80-4510-b14: Thank you. But I found when something was so open to interpretation...

values.RadioData.json|RD_36b8e213-ce91-4c96-93e: And you turned to more political themes...

values.RadioData.json|RD_ce0e22a1-c60a-4408-88e: My mother had just had a bad fall in the kitchen...
values.RadioData.json|RD_f50b9e4c-32a4-4951-b5e: ... and it was inspired by a nightmare I had soon after.
values.RadioData.json|RD_69c18e40-6f66-4c05-a4b: Interesting. The mother figure, I think, plays a large role in your work...

values.RadioData.json|RD_7e499206-5d6b-44e5-94d: It's like thinking about your fingers as you play the piano...

values.RadioData.json|RD_463dad62-9d51-4dc7-962: But my own mother has a large part in my life and work.

values.RadioData.json|RD_f4908d5b-a863-4524-83d: Yes. I'm going to use it to kill the President.

values.RadioData.json|RD_58c849d1-01ea-4ddf-874: Then I will go by Artist.
values.RadioData.json|RD_1f52c0b6-d7c2-485e-bee: No matter how deep we go, the tunnel never grows dark.

values.RadioData.json|RD_3baca139-c6c1-475e-be4: You shut your eyes, Poet, and the tunnel will stay light for me.

values.RadioData.json|RD_3c6d3c75-caf5-4fb1-abb: The nation - and the world -  continues to watch a small area of Kentucky...
values.RadioData.json|RD_bb29cf31-c182-4316-ba9: ... which has now been dubbed the "Knox Exclusion Zone".
values.RadioData.json|RD_0638208e-3392-40b0-9c8: While officials downplay the danger of the virus...
values.RadioData.json|RD_6eae56ed-dd51-4e51-955: ... the actions of the military suggest they are taking no chances.
values.RadioData.json|RD_7b5cf838-8438-49c5-b22: A miles-long fence topped with razor wire south of Louisville...
values.RadioData.json|RD_67d014eb-4ffd-4278-b80: ... guarded by military patrols and, it's rumored, by machine guns on the other side...
values.RadioData.json|RD_1e2be972-9748-4ded-9e2: ... separates the Zone from the rest of Kentucky.
values.RadioData.json|RD_dcfac543-fc16-4a46-9bd: Our reporter Daryl Cranton is on the scene.
values.RadioData.json|RD_3abe6fd1-489c-442b-b3f: Empty streets. Military rule. Fear and panic.
values.RadioData.json|RD_77e89cd1-fe6d-4883-baa: I'm not describing a movie, but a scene playing out here in Kentucky.
values.RadioData.json|RD_0f5868fc-095f-4768-bbf: Several towns, including Muldraugh and West Point...
values.RadioData.json|RD_cc7205d0-5732-472a-88b: ... along with surrounding areas, are now cut off from the rest of the world.
values.RadioData.json|RD_93cb3006-4018-479a-a4c: The phones are down, and there's no way in or out.
values.RadioData.json|RD_d733a342-4f38-4ebb-8b2: Despite officials paying for accomodation for people trapped outside the Zone...
values.RadioData.json|RD_d6ce3b42-4c97-43aa-ab4: ... hundreds of tents have sprung up as people wait for a way to get inside.
values.RadioData.json|RD_a8f5c8a1-fba7-42c3-880: This isn't Russia. You can't just keep people locked up.

values.RadioData.json|RD_36f87102-b562-487d-b00: ... and today the Jansarian quarantine ends.
values.RadioData.json|RD_093c39b2-bcd5-4f4f-a00: Maybe we can finally discover what they have that's so valuable...

values.RadioData.json|RD_ea5b2c89-5b32-4cd8-894: Even the Governor of Kentucky made light of the incident, blaming fans...
values.RadioData.json|RD_791b0a6b-4a75-49c9-938: ... of a local baseball team who recently lost a game.
values.RadioData.json|RD_9a459625-c4b5-4169-848: The government maintains the lights were flares dropped from aircraft...
values.RadioData.json|RD_24dbfb69-bc26-4483-bc9: ... but Kim is far from the only one who disagrees.
values.RadioData.json|RD_75863c11-3b3c-45f2-93e: Were the Louisville Lights flares set by pranksters...

values.RadioData.json|RD_0989fbef-3398-4fcc-a98: Hi Don. I was head of the Intentional Release Virality Department at the CDC for 18 years.
values.RadioData.json|RD_56bd77e3-bff1-4481-b40: Basically, we invented new and deadly viruses for use in warfare.
values.RadioData.json|RD_549dc8ce-cef9-4d48-86c: The CDC has underground labs all over the country where these things are made.
values.RadioData.json|RD_9bd67057-ef45-4326-be4: So you're suggesting this virus originated from one of these bases?
values.RadioData.json|RD_e002c678-89a2-40ea-be8: Almost certainly. Specifically, it looks like a strain of Juniper-17.
values.RadioData.json|RD_b89ef7b8-974f-4706-8ce: I never heard of that. Are you pulling my leg?
values.RadioData.json|RD_b615d397-b133-42b8-aa4: No, Don. This is too serious.
values.RadioData.json|RD_1a35f228-6522-4144-87e: The thing is Don, knowing what I do about the CDC...
values.RadioData.json|RD_bbe15790-5f77-478d-abb: ... it's likely an experiment, a large scale live exercise...
values.RadioData.json|RD_0f7e67d0-995a-4d84-88e: ... that will cause many deaths, but provide the CDC with data.
values.RadioData.json|RD_99fb246f-02da-4d1c-9a2: It will all be covered up, of course.
values.RadioData.json|RD_de3f1b00-8ead-4f7e-883: It's why I left the CDC, and became a man of God.
values.RadioData.json|RD_6f7c1acf-faf9-4da8-b69: All we have left is prayer.
values.RadioData.json|RD_e0bb322e-e283-434e-a7b: Let's just look after one another.

values.RadioData.json|RD_d207130a-055b-4fb4-8ab: Then me and my friend fed in spool after spool of fishling line.

values.RadioData.json|RD_008952cc-3a03-400d-9cb: [img=music]... a big smile on your red lips... [img=music]
values.RadioData.json|RD_77132ddf-29b6-4066-8f2: [img=music] I'm going to the heat down below... [img=music]
