values.RadioData.json|RD_14b802e5-1a2b-4fa4-861: Good evening from the edge of the Mojave.
values.RadioData.json|RD_40be607e-62de-4785-b98: I'm Don Beverage and you're listening to Sea to Shining Sea.
values.RadioData.json|RD_2b2ffbf1-2cfb-4e91-931: Curfews and riots. Coast to coast chaos.
values.RadioData.json|RD_12b30c56-5ae9-4cde-a50: We're still looking for the truth here.
values.RadioData.json|RD_af5a7769-f4cc-4bd6-9d7: But please remember to respect our troops.
values.RadioData.json|RD_cbd98654-8acc-49cd-92d: I've seen their faces. They're not part of a conspiracy.
values.RadioData.json|RD_b389c666-8f0b-4bbc-9ed: They're as scared as the rest of us.
values.RadioData.json|RD_41e1da44-de78-477f-9c4: And if those infected people come to your city...
values.RadioData.json|RD_7994a9dd-a28b-414e-8a3: ... you'll be glad the troops are there.
values.RadioData.json|RD_719e4759-c60e-4136-a54: Let's throw open the phone lines.
values.RadioData.json|RD_8c09d393-3dff-4741-807: Hello. You're on Sea to Shining Sea.
values.RadioData.json|RD_e2d9dd20-604b-445f-b5e: Hi Don. Melissa here. I just escaped Louisville with my two children.
values.RadioData.json|RD_5c6a8d06-83c2-4523-af3: We had to crawl over the traffic jam on the bridge...
values.RadioData.json|RD_ff0fc8df-467e-432a-bc1: There were soldiers there. They didn't want to let us through...
values.RadioData.json|RD_35761d51-6964-490c-85d: But their officer said it was okay.
values.RadioData.json|RD_9c9cd604-2e30-4e86-b89: Said they'd be pulling north themselves soon.
values.RadioData.json|RD_d1ed684d-d1b2-4193-888: I don't know. I don't care. We've nowhere to go.
values.RadioData.json|RD_04b93a5d-243c-4a68-b93: All the houses along the way are already looted.
values.RadioData.json|RD_cc8bdf3b-fb4f-4dd0-b43: At least we spent the night indoors.
values.RadioData.json|RD_626869f3-1633-4112-9a0: But my youngest is coughing a lot...
values.RadioData.json|RD_07c62e65-6ab0-4dd3-864: I thought maybe you could help us Don.
values.RadioData.json|RD_f0c1eb6e-dce7-48b0-a3e: Maybe you know someone who can give us a cure...
values.RadioData.json|RD_1c07a7ab-2d0c-4314-9f5: Melissa... I'm sorry. I don't think I can help.
values.RadioData.json|RD_6c253aa3-3323-453b-9a2: [img=music] Hold me gently, keep me close... [img=music]
values.RadioData.json|RD_2b04b633-1844-4ad1-931: [img=music] You are my darling, my love, always in my heart. [img=music]
values.RadioData.json|RD_7230014d-3ba4-43f6-b09: [img=music] Hold me softly, keep me warm... [img=music]
values.RadioData.json|RD_3eb3ac64-980e-4ca2-981: [img=music] If loving you is a crime, it's guilty I plead. [img=music]
values.RadioData.json|RD_ac90db10-a786-4d5f-91f: [img=music] Hold me kindly, keep me true... [img=music]
values.RadioData.json|RD_ed267c59-0459-461c-9e9: [img=music] My love for you will last until my dying day... [img=music]
values.RadioData.json|RD_7ed7d947-a03d-4ea2-9a9: Now here's a little song we sing.
values.RadioData.json|RD_8b6ab5fe-a8e3-4bd7-846: It's called... The Ballad of Brian Hicks.
values.RadioData.json|RD_3047167b-5766-4f03-888: [img=music] I once knew a man in a faraway land. [img=music]
values.RadioData.json|RD_b286a68d-278f-4c17-bd1: [img=music] Said I'd write him a song, when I had a band. [img=music]
values.RadioData.json|RD_9ccc6f85-b9ef-4a4d-881: [img=music] He was someplace in Europe, right in the sticks. [img=music]
values.RadioData.json|RD_66efa521-6021-49be-89c: [img=music] The man, the legend, Brian Hicks. [img=music]
values.RadioData.json|RD_9d46ea20-de7f-4743-9d0: [img=music] How can we one day be like Brian? [img=music]
values.RadioData.json|RD_94b66936-1d34-403e-a19: [img=music] How could we dream to reach so high? [img=music]
values.RadioData.json|RD_d45d908e-60da-4e13-a7a: [img=music] To being such... a... lovely... guy! [img=music]
values.RadioData.json|RD_58edb861-d547-451b-930: Thank you Czech Republic! We love you!
values.RadioData.json|RD_3fdb68aa-fd29-423e-b49: [img=music] We talked the night, till the sun came up. [img=music]
values.RadioData.json|RD_9bdafdd1-8419-4686-940: [img=music] You said it was over. It can't be over. [img=music]
values.RadioData.json|RD_3d250e2d-fa59-4f2d-b10: [img=music] You looked at me like a stranger. [img=music]
values.RadioData.json|RD_6fa636f2-70b9-4a7c-917: [img=music] I skated downtown, saw lovers having fun. [img=music]
values.RadioData.json|RD_1560ece4-25b2-4528-a24: [img=music] I thought of you, and what you'd done. [img=music]
values.RadioData.json|RD_2995007d-dbc7-4398-9f9: [img=music] You've made me who I am! [img=music]
values.RadioData.json|RD_dd3dad82-61e1-4f75-a3b: [img=music] Now it's come to me. It's over. [img=music]

values.RadioData.json|RD_afbbba04-aaa7-45f9-a3b: [img=music] You've made me who I am! [img=music]
values.RadioData.json|RD_1fc06f59-8db7-4b8a-9ad: Don Beverage, still at the edge of the Mojave.
values.RadioData.json|RD_2690d344-5a81-4182-b09: My wife Camille... she has the fever.
values.RadioData.json|RD_17659716-bdd9-47ac-8b0: Haven't seen each other or anyone else for days.
values.RadioData.json|RD_5b808387-a97b-43d4-a27: I've got enough food and water here.
values.RadioData.json|RD_24f7c5d0-a01a-4240-869: Why are we trying to survive?
values.RadioData.json|RD_ae115194-6e9c-49ab-8f7: [img=music] Down the road, I met a man in red. [img=music]
values.RadioData.json|RD_af8f8048-56a3-418a-877: [img=music] Looked at me like he wished I was dead. [img=music]
values.RadioData.json|RD_10c2d8a8-bc6d-44ca-ba9: [img=music] As I got closer, he smiled and said... [img=music]
values.RadioData.json|RD_4d15e23a-88cb-40d5-970: [img=music] "Will you make an honest deal with me?" [img=music]
values.RadioData.json|RD_c960b71a-1161-47f1-9f8: [img=music] "I'm a fallen angel, got no cloud..." [img=music]
values.RadioData.json|RD_089193c6-7c2f-4b74-9b5: [img=music] "I can get back if I make God proud." [img=music]
values.RadioData.json|RD_fa4da0d8-0d37-4e15-90b: [img=music] "Give me your soul, and as a reward..." [img=music]
values.RadioData.json|RD_deafdc51-0fc2-4de8-91c: [img=music] "Your wildest dreams will come through henceforth." [img=music]
values.RadioData.json|RD_2f040b2b-31f3-4bb5-970: [img=music] I said, "Your Lord ain't the one I know..." [img=music]
values.RadioData.json|RD_c32e9625-0b79-4445-ab6: [img=music] The man vanished in a cloud of smoke. [img=music]
values.RadioData.json|RD_a6824c71-bd05-4da1-8c1: [img=music] Thought I did right, sending him away... [img=music]
values.RadioData.json|RD_cf541624-3579-4888-acb: [img=music] But on lonely nights, I regret it... [img=music]
values.RadioData.json|RD_afcc9e3d-33d5-4481-80c: Don Beverage. I took a big risk.
values.RadioData.json|RD_d13aa873-d378-4441-a01: I went back to see my wife.
values.RadioData.json|RD_8a190c0e-c73e-4e2f-bd0: She saw me. Or at least... she turned to me.
values.RadioData.json|RD_10d8baf4-e55c-4498-970: Staring through the window, with these...
values.RadioData.json|RD_71e9b0fd-3f09-473a-83a: She started clawing at the glass.
values.RadioData.json|RD_931ff888-e050-44f1-ac5: Don Beverage. I can't believe it.
values.RadioData.json|RD_5f9f7307-0b20-4e7e-88a: At least, from the flu that spreads through the air...
values.RadioData.json|RD_80d8acba-16f5-429e-8e8: I know this because four soldiers came to see me.
values.RadioData.json|RD_e2a28141-c8ed-4dda-991: Said they're evacuating from Nellis, because it's too close to Vegas.
values.RadioData.json|RD_21e9fddd-eaef-41ea-923: They... laid Camille to rest for me.
values.RadioData.json|RD_0ec55d01-f2a0-4d36-bb9: The power and transmitters and so on are going to fail soon.
values.RadioData.json|RD_98703e07-0d6c-4152-a79: The four guys said they'd see about getting me set up...
values.RadioData.json|RD_b270f994-8bef-4309-841: Don't expect to hear me east of Nevada unless you've got a powerful radio.
values.RadioData.json|RD_81684ca1-7d8f-42ab-9dc: I've got a long helicopter ride now.
values.RadioData.json|RD_793273c9-69bf-4763-9ad: I don't know what's waiting for me on the other side.
values.RadioData.json|RD_21990ace-bac5-4cbd-8d1: I've been Don Beverage. Look out for each other, America.

values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_9c5aa288-f34a-4a8: Their skin was blue and so smooth, and they had big black eyes.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_d85066e2-0786-4a7: But there was something wrong with...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_eeca5d13-1378-469: No please. Stop it. Stop looking at me... His eyes... they're in me...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_b0295cbe-4301-49e: So what exactly happened to Harry and Hannah Barrett?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_efa5f51b-c12d-492: Was it just overactive imaginations that made their nightmares real...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_73663638-dd71-458: ... or had they really been taken by alien beings and experimented on?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_0e933f10-329f-46d: Welcome. I'm Edward Stack. Tonight we head to a remote area in Utah.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_19e1150f-2a9c-4a6: The maps call it Bluesprings Ranch. But the locals have another name for it.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_3f9d7a25-0ec2-496: I owned Bluesprings Ranch for three years, and I lost three quarters of my cattle.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_ce929807-d2f9-433: Became a running joke in the town. John Gorman's breeding cows for the aliens.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_4d4b3de5-ee68-465: I never saw no aliens, but I saw my cattle drained of blood. Dismembered.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_f51fb4a8-a2c4-48c: I saw lights in the sky. I saw a gigantic wolf impervious to my Magnum's bullets.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_f0de23d7-bc2d-416: There used to be holes in the sky, and things looking down at us.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_594b9b98-10e5-42f: I tried to take pictures, but the things seemed to know they were being filmed.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_6edb0c56-8a27-425: People say I'm crazy or I'm making it all up for money.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_34800cce-e145-406: My whole family must be crazy too because we all saw these things.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_86ff0706-5e19-47c: I sold the ranch for half what I paid for it in the end.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_04d15119-84a9-4e2: I've gotten my cattle through droughts, tornadoes, disease...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_209d2731-3d4e-464: ... but Bluesprings Ranch was the end of them.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_9f997869-fb3f-473: So what exactly is Bluesprings Ranch?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_50bad338-e013-481: Did John Gorman make it all up for publicity, or is the ranch...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_65bc4963-7bc6-4bd: ... as some people speculate... a gateway to another dimension?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_a93b3cbe-de2e-4e7: Welcome. I'm Edward Stack. This evening we head back to Kentucky...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_0fdace79-a9ba-4e6: ... to the city of Louisville, and recall a windy night in March 1991...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_ab6dfefc-1a88-455: ... when the night sky was filled with strange lights of an unknown origin.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_938bf5c7-7569-412: I saw the craft, hovering above Spiff's headquarters.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_a1b0136a-8340-445: Kim Jackson was one of thousands of witnesses to the event.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_71519329-4dcb-475: My son is in the Air Force and he told me flares only burn for a few minutes at most.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_713cfa30-a28c-41d: It was there for nearly an hour, moving slow. Then it shot off over the Ohio river.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_79998105-f424-432: It's hard to judge things at night, but it must have been hundreds of feet long.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_5d1d7d1d-36db-474: I know my photos and everyone else's only show the lights...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_7c1b48cb-bd9d-464: ... but it was solid. Silent and black and shaped like a V.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_cf9c2781-dbf6-4a8: Just looking at them made you feel odd, like something bad was going to happen...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_c715d70f-0bb9-4ac: Even the Governor of Kentucky made light of the incident, blaming fans...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_def99ac1-627d-4f8: ... of a local baseball team who recently lost a game.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_2c783680-df62-435: The government maintains the lights were flares dropped from aircraft...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_a5b8fc0a-a450-4bb: ... but Kim is far from the only one who disagrees.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_b092ddd3-88b5-46c: Were the Louisville Lights flares set by pranksters...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_70363d04-ce0d-485: ... or did something otherworldly pass over the city on that night in 1991?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_37c19819-800a-404: S2.05 - The Haunted Hunting Lodge of Valley Station
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_b12500d5-913e-487: Welcome. I'm Edward Stack. Tonight we head once more to Kentucky...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_6ab35417-8370-431: ... to a small town by the Ohio River named Valley Station.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_bb4e0e1b-0d32-4a0: Even at the height of the hunting season, everyone knows not to stay...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_3aec409e-41d7-47e: ... in a certain lodge in the wilderness to the east of the town.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_07e0dae2-ecdc-45f: I'd never heard anything about it. I was just there to shoot deer.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_f9ec2c34-f105-4ce: Fred Gunderson spent a night with a friend in the lodge one December.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_af693404-676f-4ba: But after midnight, odd things started to happen.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_dc270707-95df-475: The door at the back was banging. I got up and locked it.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_a75054d4-35c5-44e: Five minutes later, same thing happened. Then again. Three times.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_1dae1258-a064-483: I got mad with my friend. I was sure he was pranking me.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_6edb48a3-b632-498: Then we found a note on the floor, in front of the big fireplace.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_84e8d297-d029-46f: It said "I'm stalking you from the shadows.". We were terrified.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_46033ddf-b359-4e1: I made sure everything was locked, and there was no-one inside.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_85843bfb-5e0e-495: I made real sure. Then we went back to bed.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_5ac8a7d0-53bb-4f6: We were about to sleep when the whole house started shaking.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_95e7780a-d348-4ae: All the cupboards flew open, and all our stuff - even our heavy rifles...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_1d99ace2-676c-467: ... starting flying around the room. Then this huge, demonic voice said...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_886c09ba-da23-493: "I will destroy those who defy me."
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_e89881df-a08e-47a: Not ashamed to say we ran like rabbits the hell out of there.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_ad603c0d-2000-488: Anyone would have. Ain't never going there again. Never.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_28c275d3-ef93-458: What exactly happened to these men? Were they the subject of a prank...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_9d9db46b-bbf3-4c5: ... or is there a lodge near Valley Station, filled with long deceased lodgers...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_d0973a46-0148-459: ... waiting for their moment to strike?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_b03d6719-703e-4e4: Hello, Father McCarthy. I'm Father David Mullen.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_a23ac5d3-b79a-48f: Ah, you made it over from London alright then?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_dcc6a7e2-cdc3-411: Looking forward to helping me out in our little town?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_edd70be1-2d26-40c: Yes, Father. I can't wait to get started.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_0b01681c-0108-489: Sure it's a lovely day, thank God. I'll bring you on a tour of the town.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_2e47e4f6-f336-462: Here's our church where we'll be saying our masses. Small but cozy.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_408cd3fc-bb27-4ea: Here's the one shop in town. Foley's. Paula Foley is a bit of a gossip, God bless her.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_5f3f3bf9-9690-4e0: And finally here's the pub you'll find me most days.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_fda0ceeb-65dc-4ac: Oh, you have a friend today, Father.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_50c2d10e-d33f-403: This is Father David, over from England.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_19eb1d2c-d41a-46d: Are all the English priests so handsome?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_079bbf50-3a81-4b0: I think you're going to enjoy working in Ballincoolin, Father David.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_414bec56-6066-415: Oh, hello Father. I'm Paddy Moore, general dogsbody.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_5db3c9ea-2663-4ec: Jacinta over at the pub is me daughter.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_1e4428fb-bafa-4d4: She's been talking about the handsome new priest all week.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_388eaa94-a256-4f6: I think she has her eye on you.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_1deb8ba5-66a6-4ac: Her eye on... oh dear. I'm a man of the cloth, Mr. Moore.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_bfb9e931-0124-4a2: And she herself used to be a woman of the veil. A nun. But she left the convent.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_d5db0794-ef92-450: A beautiful girl like that? That's hard to believe.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_494c8c04-241d-4e6: Aye. Problem is she thinks the town is a type of convent too.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_318e04b3-f788-4a8: Says it's boring and nothing ever changes.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_51d4f0b7-0fc7-42a: But something's changed now, hasn't it, Father?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_eaa51b4c-5cb0-4fa: Barely here, and half the hearts of the town already melting over you...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_45dca4e3-a923-4a1: Hello there, Father. I haven't seen you for a while.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_845a0f1e-bac7-416: Oh, no, Jacinta, no not at all. I've been busy with masses and getting settled in.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_4bd04cf1-4017-401: That's good to hear. Will you be going to the donkey cart race?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_96fb038a-6511-4c7: Oh, it's the local annual tradition. The two rival families...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_47330e07-d5c2-4d9: ... the Kavanaghs and the Rourkes settle their differences with a race.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_2d7c2435-c498-440: Jacinta, Jacinta! I've been looking everywhere for you. The Kavanagh's driver's taken ill.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_143b7705-4294-486: Oh no. Is there a replacement?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_56a07e90-0473-4d6: The rules has to be an outsider.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_fb8c164c-0408-40f: Me? Oh no. No. I have work to do. Sorry. No.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_c35c5cd8-26d4-4b4: Oh crikey, I'm going to win!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_13055e6f-f623-463: Oh, Father David! I can't believe you won the donkey cart race!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_bf448de1-941f-414: Oh, I'm so sorry. I wasn't thinking...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_75de3160-5877-476: You're the most popular person in Ballincoolin, Father.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_fa4f712f-3a1f-4f6: An endorsement from you could easily win me the election.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_6b43272e-2e35-440: I'm sorry Mr. Rourke, but no.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_cf452608-943c-4ff: You're hardly going to endorse Kavanagh?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_74775e1b-2da7-453: I'm not endorsing anyone. I don't believe the Church should get involved in local politics.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_109cdb5e-f06d-426: Endorse me, Father, and we'll find the money to fix the church's roof.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_53e616ba-12ce-40c: Maybe even a new car for yourself.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_0edb9256-e785-461: That's a horrible thought, Mr. Rourke. Bribery and corruption. Please leave. Now.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_4ef40095-d6b3-4ea: I'm going to run for the election. Paddy Moore, councilor. Sounds good, doesn't it?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_af54f1f1-eb3a-499: Ah Da, you're not. You don't know anything about politics.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_14b09453-09db-4ca: I know the Rourkes and Kavanaghs have controlled this town for too long.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_d5bd9e0d-db92-4b4: And I know with your help, Father, I can win it.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_8c6bb07d-b6f5-4cd: I don't know if I should...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_1a342d20-3ab6-444: And by one vote, Paddy Moore is elected!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_873c29f1-8b81-45f: I did it! I did it! All thanks to you, Father Mullen.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_4fe63879-1dc1-4d7: I did it for you, Jacinta.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_3cc50b37-07b5-4ff: No, no, no. I've stayed silent long enough. You made a vow...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_874ba614-7223-4fd: But Father McCarthy, what Jacinta and I have is chaste. It's harmless...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_229f2e74-2b62-411: And how long will that last? How can a man resist the temptations of London...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_2b9607f3-83d0-43e: ... and fall to the whispers of Satan in Ballincoolin?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_4144cc91-6589-407: You have to make a choice, David: the priesthood, or Jacinta.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_77ba582c-20ee-46d: I could never ask you to give everything up for me, David.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_23f75af7-9ea5-4c5: I know you wouldn't. That's what makes it so hard. If you asked me to, I would.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_71f90793-d8a2-428: I'm leaving Ballincoolin tonight and going back to London.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_c886e839-244e-4a2: I have to Jacinta. I have to.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_99138d76-6353-45c: You didn't have to come with me to the airport.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_7147508b-7014-4c4: Yes, I did. Because it's only now, when there's no choice, I can pick up the courage.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_77f36cc4-50a0-41b: Leave the priesthood, David. Stay with me. Marry me.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_8012da4a-a00e-46c: But I can't. I have to go. It's too late. It's too late...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_a5590d2f-f23b-43f: It's not too late. It's never too late.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_05e83d28-6484-40e: Well... can I have a lift back to Ballincoolin?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_b6ba60c7-0840-404: Space date 7431A. We remain in the proximity of the Aurora galaxy...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_463fe54d-6f2b-442: ... but can find nothing at the distress signal co-ordinates.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_26c86fb9-c28c-436: Captain, I've got something on secondary radar.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_613124f3-d360-4c7: The damaged ship is there - but it's invisible!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_a57d4f2c-4b96-42b: Distressed ship, this is Captain Juan Xiping of the spaceship Silk Road.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_7e7ef911-660a-471: Oh, thank the seven suns. Our invisibility cloak was about to go down.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_ed04c3b7-cd8c-41e: I'm captain Wopol on the Paramount, a small ship from Jansaria.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_197779a1-3576-43c: I have very valuable cargo, but Kerlan pirates attacked us.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_d12fdac6-b523-456: Please, beam me and my men aboard. You can have my cargo.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_8234cba9-db2e-42a: We require no payment for rescuing you.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_35eebec1-7a53-432: You can't be fecking serious, sir. They could be pirates themselves!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_64be6c6e-8f7f-4c3: We don't have time to argue. Their ship is about to break apart.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_71e4ae65-9f58-41b: On your head be it, sir.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_c7272a54-f9a7-4f9: S3.02 - Attack of The Kerlan Pirates
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_ee94bd08-0e14-4dd: Space date 7436A. We have left the proximity of the Aurora galaxy.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_8450e258-7f4c-444: The Jansarians remain in quarantine. They seem to be small time smugglers.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_590ef27e-4012-424: Now continuing our original mission to trade outpost 66B.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_948b6b9c-713f-4b0: You should get some rest, Juan.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_afdd9289-728e-44a: You don't have to watch the smugglers all the time.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_bb8cbbd3-652c-430: We're missing a piece of the puzzle, Sam.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_18848d9b-6bbe-4a5: Well, at least have some space coffee, you're going to fall asleep...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_d2d20763-83cb-494: Captain six... no, twelve Kerlan ships have warped in!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_f7c14ac7-a30c-4e0: Get us out of here, Colin!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_10041d91-d0bd-45a: Space date 7442A. We successfully escaped the  Kerlan attack...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_63e1b511-37ca-425: ... and today the Jansarians' quarantine ends.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_9f01424d-01f7-4dd: Maybe we can figure out what they have that's so valuable...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_d777f179-8e92-43f: Captain Juan. Our quarantine is over?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_d51f430f-0722-463: That's right, Captain Wopol. But you're the reason the Kerlans attacked us.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_6bca1dfe-f56f-47b: You're smuggling something valuable, you said. And yet our scanners...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_e3983953-2a2a-4a6: ... only found machine parts and Tamarian oils.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_0931bf4c-a5d7-415: I see... Thank you for saving us, Captain. But the truth is...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_95e6f9a2-6cd1-4ec: ... we don't know what our valuable item actually is.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_57f8776e-b02f-413: I followed a strange signal and found it floating near a black hole.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_e6bebc60-69eb-48e: We knew it was special just by looking at it. It's like it was watching us.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_2c4bd11f-c82f-42a: If it's endangering this ship, you can dispose of it. Here.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_61c60e9f-ea88-4f3: Looks like an ordinary small black pyramid to me. A souvenir perhaps.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_2942d450-8284-432: And yet... I can't look away from it. Could it be... no, it's not possible...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_ad16cf76-040a-4ae: Sir, you're not going to believe this.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_aba367fc-30cd-4aa: But, out of nowhere, a new planet just appeared on our scope!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_c3648ad8-dcbc-4c1: Space date 7444A. The Jansarians have left us and taken their cargo...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_8482b303-820c-46e: ... apart from the little black pyramid. It fascinates the crew and I...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_c9a88069-362c-497: ... but we can't figure out why.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_99ffa315-5aa5-480: And now a whole new planet has appeared nearby, and we're going to explore it.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_8aaffd58-ff5e-45d: Earth-like planet. Very earth-like. But definitely an alien planet that isn't earth.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_23135c9d-ecde-413: It looks just like home, and yet different somehow.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_1ae10e34-5d89-4c2: Is that... a town? By the forest.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_330906fa-7bee-4e7: Looks just like a place on Earth, before it was destroyed...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_606df38f-b0d1-4dc: It wants us to go there.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_c8b234dc-180b-41c: I know what this thing is now.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_44ca22be-b494-4ac: It is. And it's pointing us home!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_0880936b-cd38-42b: Space date 7444A. We remain on the surface of the planet.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_073a8bee-c4a1-474: It's just like Earth. It's just like home. The pyramid of Ollarf is pointing the way.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_fe137512-4117-4f6: No, it can't be. That's... the house I grew up in. I thought it was gone forever.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_c02fc092-aa11-4dd: Over there... my uncle's cabin. Where I built my first android.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_3dc38038-d7b8-483: Joy, don't run! It could be a trap!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_3e9054a8-1273-446: NO TRAP, CAPTAIN! YOU ARE HOME!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_5dbdc709-5e42-453: No... it can't be. Mom... Dad... you're alive...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_04c62e61-1153-42c: Captain? Captain? Oh my God. The planet has just disappeared.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_2b2e4e8d-a4b8-408: Captain, the Silk Road needs you, or we'll never be able to fly home.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_b1f3856a-0e1c-4b9: ... All I'm saying is you don't know what's in that hair supplement, Herb.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_5f5d6a71-9c83-41c: But Marie, the bald man is the most discriminated against in America.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_028378c1-e42c-4d9: We're laughed at, talked down to...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_1f086681-2e8e-431: Well that ends today, thanks for Peroxinil!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_3935b097-68e7-43c: Ah, there you are Thompson. My, what a luscious head of hair.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_8e0924e9-3ff7-48e: A fellow with a mane like that shouldn't languish in the Lower Sector.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_c88de8ea-da55-4e9: How would you like an executive position?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_c884fe15-7eac-45c: Marie, you have to help me! I'm out of Peroxinil! My hair's falling out again!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_e8d1b58c-fdb4-4fc: I'm sorry Herbie, but Congress just banned it...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_94ba35e7-bca9-41f: Thompson! What happened to your hair?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_84e35cd6-0177-42a: No skinskull can be an executive! Back to the Lower Sector with you...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_eb7abe88-ea19-474: <sigh> I guess I'm just meant to be bald.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_a40e977a-b29f-4b2: Well, you'll always be my favorite baldie...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_0b732cb9-a9a3-49e: ... Do you have an idea how we should use our four million dollars, sir?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_cb78659f-904c-491: I'll do better than that, Mayor Grimsby. I'll show you in song!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_6bcbeda5-cc2c-40e: [img=music] There's nothing like a sturdy, five car high speed tram...[img=music]
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_bacb7e60-ea9f-4d1: [img=music] I hear those trams make a lot of noise...[img=music]
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_1e378b74-c249-491: [img=music] Not with our tramway's special alloys. [img=music]
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_79369029-83ab-4d2: [img=music] What are the odds of a derailing? [img=music]
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_33e96a5e-bf6f-4fd: [img=music] There's more chance of the sunrise failing! [img=music]
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_5739f61c-bf88-4a9: [img=music] What about all the weirdo and creeps? [img=music]
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_c7825031-fbb4-452: [img=music] They'll be given all the cheapest seats. [img=music]
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_b53a5cd7-bdfa-4eb: [img=music] I think you're one of Satan's minions! [img=music]
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_c9407e6d-71ca-40e: [img=music] Well good sir, that's just your opinion. [img=music]
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_d4386718-efdf-444: [img=music] I swear it's this town's only chance...[img=music]
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_5353eb00-4fac-43d: [img=music] Throw up your hands and do a dance![img=music]
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_67791988-49e8-4a1: ... Wow, Mrs Thompson, thank you for putting out the fire in the library!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_eb3cadbc-d70b-400: Have you considered joining the town's fire department?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_c6cde255-9f5b-43c: But Marie, if you're a firefighter, who's going to cook dinner?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_fb098820-0fc4-4d1: Oh Herbie, I'll leave everything in the oven. Just switch it on...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_8d35f76a-c3ff-437: Great work, Thompson. You just cleared our training course in record time!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_e15f6e4f-1df3-44b: *radio crackles* Five alarm fire, on Clowater Street.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_c4e519a0-9c4e-4e8: Oh Herbie, it's okay, the fire's out now!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_067dd8bb-52b7-4eb: Oh Marie, I didn't know you're not supposed to put foil in the microwave...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_80e58fc8-cdd9-495: <sigh> I guess true firefighting... starts in the home.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_7f1bbe7f-690e-401: I'm sorry Marie. I know that job meant a lot to you...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_01918ae7-ea49-451: That's okay Herbie. You light my fire every day.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_8e60e9c1-38de-498: These test results are terrible, Lester.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_a9128651-d4b6-421: Sorry. I've been under a lot of stress. What with the economy and all...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_5bc1fc96-d631-4e1: Don't crack wise, young man. Detention until you start studying.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_bb5a48ac-58f0-417: This sucks. Home after dark. Barely time to drop a cinder block off the overpass...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_a3f01401-edb6-496: I know just how you feel, son.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_2d600fdd-ddce-4e5: When I was your age, things were sucky too. Do you know what I did?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_a0490b17-6069-44d: Studied hard and passed your tests?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_c35e6403-779d-444: Hell no. I bribed a smarter kid to pass me the answers.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_79f17cd7-ec1d-4c7: Wow Lester, these results are something else.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_4445c56c-9447-4e5: Thank you, ma'am. I merely applied my perspicacity.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_aa7c6a0f-4b69-43a: ... Psst, you were supposed to pass me the right answers, Taylor.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_a0d018b3-9b38-40f: You shouldn't have dropped a cinder block on my dad's convertible, Lester.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_c7cff523-8935-4ed: The whole town can't be under the control of aliens, Lester!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_07eccfcb-1bf5-489: I'm just telling you what I saw, Eliza.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_0872ea8f-aa99-4e8: Mayor Grimsby and Chief Johnson speaking in an unknown language...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_c77808c0-c6a8-42d: They're just practising for the local play. It's in French.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_7984d198-3237-41c: How can Mom and Dad be controlled by aliens?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_132b27c7-3df3-41d: There must be a mothership where all the aliens are.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_49109aed-9e0b-4fc: Stop enslaving our town, you big slimy monsters!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_8e021fe1-338b-4c9: Enslavement? We are merely showing your people visions of a better future.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_bdc8fbaa-01bb-42e: We have misjudged you humans. You are petty and cynical.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_feeeae7f-379c-45f: You are not ready to join our intergalactic federation of love and happiness.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_e54f5b41-0930-45e: Well done Lester. Now we'll never have world peace.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_f5615d3b-15fe-4ac: Well Larry you caught that shoplifter, but you caused...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_ef4752cc-8cee-4f1: ... $50 million in damage to city property!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_f3cd7557-0434-4d0: I oughta bust you down to Traffic, but instead I'm giving you a new partner...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_6b0dc2bb-dc13-4ff: Hi Inspector Salatch, I'm Mindy Cooper.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_70aa8623-6f32-499: *radio static* All units, come in. Bank robbery in progress on 54th Street...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_5724fe48-1735-4bd: Looks like you two have got your first case.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_05566288-7a84-421: Listen up, coppers! We've got hostages. We want a car, a plane, several jetpacks...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_24f3aeb1-05ec-4be: We'd better sneak in the back way, Larry.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_4e7ec8d9-9b8f-4d7: Typical female hysteria. I have a better idea.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_7dd60015-3fb2-4f2: Congratulations Larry, you just shot four cops.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_458dbba8-feae-4f8: Oh... Well, it was their fault for standing there with guns!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_d9e98835-0e7d-431: I'm Inspector Cooper. What do we have on the victim?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_ed4b64a9-8c02-4ba: Kevin Ragotti. Owned this restaurant. Seems someone poisoned his cannoli.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_6481986f-661b-4b3: Did you see anyone suspicious, Mrs. Ragotti?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_c8c7c31c-8d7d-45c: A man, in a long coat. I saw him pouring white powder on Kevin's cannoli.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_22cc036f-a1b2-4fa: A long coat? Must be someone from the Long Coat District...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_a811a235-a4d2-448: There's no Long Coat District, Larry...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_675db5bb-6cfd-463: Did Kevin have any enemies, Mrs. Ragotti?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_da4011e9-9ba4-442: No, no-one at all. Well, except for his childhood nemesis Eddie Pantoni...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_94e0003a-ebc7-48a: ... who just set up a rival restaurant across the street and said he'd kill Kevin.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_8a7ae86a-cbf6-458: Don't waste our time with phony leads, ma'am. Tell us something we can use!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_659b9c25-5f92-49f: Got a new case for you and Cooper, Larry. There's a sniper going around town...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_365345b2-53a2-49b: ... shooting sandwiches out of people's hands.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_9cdd0be6-0bc5-4bd: The press have dubbed him "The Sandwich Sniper."
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_0585f389-5511-453: Just when I thought I'd seen every type of lowlife scum the streets have to offer...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_a224d075-2764-46d: *radio static* Okay, I see you, Larry. Just play it cool...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_0d0e8528-6b91-462: Boy, I sure do love sitting here in the open holding a delicious sandwich.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_067c8ae7-98a3-405: This sandwich contains parmesan, salami, chili sauce, and is served on rye bread...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_f6b7cb67-6607-4af: I would hate for it to be destroyed by a long range shot.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_28f9bc3f-431f-465: Biting into the sandwich now... mmm...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_3fe5ef92-fe2b-41a: *radio static* Larry, come in! He just shot the sandwich out of my hand!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_e5c1ea8e-fbab-441: *radio static* I see him, fifth floor, to the north! Get after him!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_5e453434-c8ec-4a7: Well Salatch, you just blew up the city's entire industrial district to catch three jaywalkers!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_8b9bef35-445e-4d5: I hope their insurance is up to date.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_46425c39-9e75-4ee: Mr. Salatch. My name is Juan Droogman. I hear you've left the force...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_1aa221ce-7563-464: Fancy doing a job for me? It skirts the bounds of legality...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_167547e9-2f93-429: Well, those student loans won't pay for themselves...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_0fb1e26e-db25-422: Great! You'll be guarding my men while they move some powders around...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_3beac2dd-c66d-4bf: Boy, it sure is great to work here in the drug warehouse, moving drugs...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_7ab0f3fc-41e8-4e2: The police are ruled by bureaucracy and will never find us!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_318d7d6f-05bd-4de: Who am I kidding? I'm not a drugman - I'm a cop!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_3962a1b3-b2f6-463: I don't approve of your methods, Salatch, but you get results.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_4cb0ea7a-faea-447: I can't believe this is how our lives end.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_0a680bc4-49e3-4b6: Trapped in a subway station, about to be obliterated by a bomb...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_639518b4-0119-442: ... planted by your worst enemy, Dmitri Pavlova.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_3c8a9ec0-4253-44a: At least I die beside the city's most beautiful police officer...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_dfa15147-2c50-42c: You're not so bad looking yourself, Larry.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_27575f17-2448-4e3: You know, at first I thought you would be weak and womanly, but...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_80f7d9dd-e985-47b: ... you're the best partner I've had since Rykon 3000. And he was a robot from the future.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_aaf4a4b7-925a-42d: That's so sweet. Let's not give up.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_347add2e-f4b6-46a: Maybe we can defuse the bomb.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_f8a765cc-2831-4b8: But if we cut the wrong wire, the city'll blow up...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_00a3e2e0-49aa-4c4: Red, green, yellow... which one do we cut?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_66e7b868-0bd3-4b6: Green. It's got to be green.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_40124b2d-7ee3-47a: It worked! Why'd you choose green?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_6d46b98d-1692-431: Because it's the color of your eyes...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_d7954c3a-8e8f-459: [img=music] Sworn to protect the innocent, there for every incident! [img=music]
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_b76f12c8-7db4-457: [img=music] Deep down in your hearts: We are the Moderators! [img=music]
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_359ce423-d6a2-402: Welcome to my Ice Palace, friends. From here: we strike back.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_c48a884e-40b9-437: How can we fight a force imbued with our own power?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_c088cdd0-a456-42a: I see the fool who hurled ArchDuke OldWorld into the Chaos Abyss is among us?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_46e2cf47-475f-4ba: I cast the fiend into the pit to SAVE all we know!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_937d7ce5-f46b-4da: Yet now the ArchDuke runs rampant through our flock!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_96dea670-fe9a-404: He bends and warps their reality! What is known becomes changed!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_993d6c13-77bd-4b0: The greatest calamity since the time of the Dark One is at hand!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_a50cb044-5822-444: I feel the rage of a thousand suns!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_69af223f-5a36-4ef: Be calm! My frozen walls melt! They begin to flow free!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_d3fa3d6a-f28e-4c3: Use your arcane understanding of the mind!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_c0adc765-76d8-46c: Becalm him! Before my Celestial Ice Palace floods our land!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_52cdd557-1a41-47e: Feel my ancestral power oh friend!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_e1dc9bda-1408-4a6: This meeting has been convened at a time of dire need.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_9719cdfd-233e-45a: I agree, my good and worthy companion.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_9550e8eb-38f2-403: I awoke to fresh frost atop my ice palace.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_76cb9435-84f6-48e: As if no time has passed since ArchDuke OldWorld was hurled into the Chaos Abyss.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_20e94d1e-dea5-48a: The people are restless. We must act.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_cd4eb8cb-2b2a-494: BUT HOW CAN YOU ACT, WHEN I...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_7d88bb20-2e20-401: BY CASTING ME INTO THE CHAOS ABYSS YOU HAVE IMBUED ME...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_903832ed-8dcc-4f6: WITH THE POWER OF THE MODERATORS THEMSELVES!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_72d1edb7-07ac-486: But, this is what was foretold!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_1261f76a-13a2-40f: WELCOME MODERATORS. YOU AWAKE IN CHAINS!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_90276b00-d960-45d: THE AGE OF ARCHDUKE OLDWORLD BEGINS AGAIN.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_f32d5847-594f-4c9: WHILE YOUR THREE FRIENDS FOUGHT, I STOLE YOU AS YOU SLEPT.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_6f808cc1-4e23-4d1: Young one? Is that you I see in the darkness?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_4d0ff7ec-c8db-4ec: IT IS HE! YOU THOUGHT HIM DEAD, BUT NO.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_319e462f-5c66-4c5: AT DAWN I REWRITE THE COSMOS.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_d8730199-8736-406: YOU WILL PERISH TOGETHER, AS WAS FORETOLD. FAREWELL!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_fac12b87-9a03-44d: These... twenty long years I have kept something precious safe.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_daeca821-c90f-46f: Young one, what is this I see in the darkness?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_ba4e623a-72e0-41f: It is... your pole my liege. Take it.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_c88b4fcd-cafd-4df: Reunite the Moderators, in this the people's time of need.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_b8fcf616-a0eb-436: Can it be real? The Pole of Justice returned to my hand?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_7cf6efca-3b84-4ee: Save them. For now... I die...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_66fbebb9-c8f2-4e1: I care not! My rage remains undimmed!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_caf36c8a-d8ee-4e3: My powers of mental understanding begin to crumble!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_602a7d23-e98b-492: I come from the dungeons of ArchDuke OldWorld with tragic news.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_afc4f93d-b28b-437: The young one, he is dead.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_7e78ef93-9e24-41c: I am forlorn. To me, he was much akin to a son.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_6f3ce51b-d171-44b: I felt this disturbance amidst the spray of the dawn snow.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_01fa0918-546b-4df: Moderators, the time for argument is now over.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_c31cf9e4-1489-4b9: When first we discovered the Power of the Moderators, it was a time of dire need.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_05412459-bd80-4f7: The reign of the Dark One was at its height.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_45b7fe75-12c0-436: Together we fought him. Together we defeated him.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_afb9d44b-16cd-4ca: Only through unity and friendship, can we hope to repel that which follows.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_d373e0e6-47d3-49e: Who will stand with me in the fight against ArchDuke OldWorld?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_c5770873-98d1-4b5: Friends, I bear the Pole of Justice.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_afc82cdd-67b3-4e0: The final battle is at hand.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_b422dd99-a623-482: I STAND HERE WITH THE FATE OF YOUR KIN IN MY HANDS.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_023a5c2b-23bb-431: IT IS THE LAST YOU WILL KNOW.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_39b6397d-d68b-442: With this the Pole of Justice, I will smite you OldWorld!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_53632f35-ab20-453: He does not strike back alone!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_10714576-cbb2-4c2: Burn in the rage of a thousands suns!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_6b1f83b6-c7c2-44f: ARGH! HOW CAN I WITHSTAND THIS?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_4f8e3c58-ba03-460: Ahah! Our revenge is at hand!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_6d5862fb-44e9-405: I AM DEFEATED, BUT WITH MY OWN POWER OF THE MODERATORS I CAN END THIS!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_2b6a6241-b8ae-496: No! ArchDuke OldWorld! I felt it then, and I feel it now!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_69754ab9-89e6-403: There is still good in you!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_c8a73066-83fa-48c: Lay down your power, before our realm unbinds!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_08fbcd98-aa92-445: NO, I CANNOT! ALL WILL FADE!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_e4928d7b-26d4-485: You can, ArchDuke. Look to me! Feel my compassion!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_8b210325-c868-44f: THE POWER OF THE MODERATORS IS BEYOND ALL COMPREHENSION.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_a5081a02-ed79-4dc: I SHALL TAKE MY LEAVE. YOUR REALM IS SAFE.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_511f9f94-7bb0-4b9: I ONLY ASK THAT WHEN THE NIGHT SKY DARKENS, YOU REMEMBER ME
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_c6afab5e-7c1a-461: We will find a way, ArchDuke OldWorld.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_bec2ebcb-1678-406: And should you ever choose to return...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_b65b3369-732c-412: Know that we will be here to protect our people.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_9c18cc2c-89a5-443: We go by many names. But forever and a day, we shall be...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_9cc109ab-aaa6-4b0: It's time to visit the Magical Woodland!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_20359c51-385b-4b9: Hi there Spiffo! Who's your little friend?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_c2581af4-457e-4b8: Furbert the Squirrel? What a lovely acorn he's clutching.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_a0891262-a2f5-477: Such fun! Cutting wood, and making furniture!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_1c535c70-7875-406: Tables, bookcases, hat stands and chairs!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_10d310b1-ff8c-4b2: I never knew friends could have this much fun!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_692850e7-68a2-40f: You really are a special builder Furbert. So clever!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_7926988d-7fc0-414: Oh no! It's time for bed.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_913dd1c4-eba5-4ca: Good night Magical Woodland. Good night.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_e984ee6a-a5db-47c: Boris the Badger? His stripes are so lovely.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_842ae4c1-7102-44e: Seeing all the fishies swimming by!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_3a02eaa0-71d9-46b: Don't tread on the big orange fish Boris!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_7cfeabb9-f9db-401: Moley the Mole? Doesn't his nose twitch adorably?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_4c98ac8d-4dcd-4f4: Such fun! Kick and dive, and score and scamper!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_d4145e81-5ca7-411: Don't fall over on the grass Moley!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_a3ec2bfe-c6bf-414: Pancake the Hedgehog? Her eyes are so bright and so blue!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_014d39b9-b2b9-4b1: Such fun! Thinking hard and moving pieces.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_8c535e74-8811-436: Testing your cleverness and remembering rules!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_66a2342e-1003-43b: Don't dance on the chessboard Pancake!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_41d438cb-ae65-425: Fluffyfoot the Fluffy Bunny? Have you ever seen a rabbit so fluffily scrumptious?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_e941f6cd-aaeb-4c9: Such fun! Jumping and jiving, ducking and diving.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_85e7a6e9-b260-4c9: Keep on dancing Fluffyfoot! Have an amazing time!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_99054e02-01c1-4d9: If you have a problem no-one else can solve, maybe you can hire... Z-Squad
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_c2baac07-d04b-409: My husband got beat up by bikers again. If only someone could save this town...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_82a1df7d-6fa0-47a: Good day, ma'am. I may look like a fisherman...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_e02615c4-6f70-47d: ... but my name's Sam Lecter, and I'm the head of Z-Squad.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_78159fcd-5979-40d: I think we can help you with your problem...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_d5706b62-7e6f-4c4: How do you like the taste of my fists, idiot?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_0fd97cae-2461-477: Yeah, keep punching them CB! Give 'em the old one-two!

values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_b21a02f4-13b2-497: Home dye kits are a booming business, but if it's your first time...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_2dbaa635-f5c9-460: ... or your previous attempts haven't gone well...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_6ba48423-128b-4fd: ... I'm here to offer you some helpful advice.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_49e89d06-3858-4a0: Choose a dye shade close to your natural hair.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_8a0dc681-a0db-430: Dramatic changes should still be done at a salon!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_1e42fbb1-da2a-4cd: Buy more dye than you need. You don't want to run out halfway though.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_21f1608e-4af6-4ce: Begin by dyeing a few strands that won't normally show.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_1f6fe301-863e-4f6: This is the best way to make sure you have the right color.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_e6b7ba5e-92b8-42f: Lip balm around your hairline and on your ears...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_4d3d8069-2654-405: ... will stop your skin getting dyed too - not a good look!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_5f733dcf-c668-4c3: Wear disposable gloves, and only dye dry hair.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_e695f283-c3e2-4ce: Put the dye into a bowl and apply with a brush, beginning at the roots...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_23c795b7-19e2-460: Use a second mirror to ensure even coverage.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_6ddac7a4-cd97-4ec: Makeup wipes will remove any dye that gets on your skin.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_f70e9467-34db-4bc: If you want highlights, use a toothbrush or mascara brush.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_f4e00a03-0a1e-4cd: With your dyeing done, put on a shower cap to prevent dripping.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_8bef73a5-67b2-4cd: Then, your job is to maintain your hair.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_f59fa410-444c-48b: Use a color-friendly shampoo, don't wash your...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_9abd12f0-667e-493: ... hair with water, and don't let sunlight onto your hair.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_8215e646-b6b1-49b: Dial the number on screen for my special home dye kit.

values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_34d8a0e1-c42b-49f: Did you know that despite movie depictions of gun-loving police officers...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_05443706-8a3b-474: ... approximately 75% of officers never fire their weapon in the line of duty?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_9bde0de2-a86d-45d: But that doesn't mean they shouldn't be prepared to do so...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_5ae6dfbc-2449-4b8: ... as skilfully, and as efficiently as possible.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_d2b2900c-ca1d-47d: I'm Ron Carafe, former captain in the San Francisco Police Department...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_aabeeebd-de58-417: ... and today I'm going to show you the basics of handling firearms.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_0302b0f8-e962-455: The M36 .38 Special revolver is a common and reliable sidearm.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_e464f17d-43fa-461: Unlike magazine-based weapons, revolvers are far less likely to jam.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_a85449be-8a5a-439: The M36 is light and easy to handle even for an amateur.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_c5b9ccd8-bb6d-495: Let's fire a few rounds. Align the sight with the target, and squeeze the trigger...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_e52f55c7-5c31-4f6: Reloading a revolver is slower than using a magazine, but the sound is much more satisfying...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_73fd4404-b33a-407: The M9 pistol is a magazine-fed weapon that fires 9mm rounds.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_f72b24fd-2c6a-44f: Remember to rack your M9 before firing.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_258f8629-85d9-441: The M625 is a meatier revolver chambered in .45.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_ba0faf71-a03a-4af: The increased recoil means you'll have to be ready for the kick to your arm.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_de68582c-9f4c-402: Finally, hope you never come up against these. A D-E pistol and a .44 Magnum.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_5abc5ad4-5c99-452: Let's fire them both together while diving through the air...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_2cc871f4-2766-412: That was for demonstration purposes only. Do not try this in the line of duty.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_5d14e8c6-5801-4da: Local chef Yukiko Asura will teach you how to make some wonderful traditional Japanese dishes. Suitable for all cooking skill levels!
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_e4e4b45e-b9de-469: Konnichiwa. I am Yukiko Asura, head chef at The Wandering Sashimi.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_3d4fd837-76be-487: Sushi is often misunderstood by outsiders to Japan...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_24b99cdd-818f-492: ... but I am here to show you this Japanese staple...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_13679e7c-fe08-4fa: ... is something even a beginner cook can learn.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_8c9fcc85-4f6b-4cc: At its simplest, sushi is raw fish with rice.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_820d91c8-1546-492: Maki is made by adding seaweed, or avocado as is common in the USA...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_5e6a0122-1759-4d6: ... then rolling it into a cylinder and slicing it.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_3efc2620-0499-45f: An onigiri has the same ingredients as a maki...
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_c5682a23-94d0-494: ... but is a rice ball, instead of a roll.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_18ae6490-0320-416: And how about some fried shrimp, perfect for dipping in soy sauce?
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_7a5fc6d3-42e0-4c6: And finally, the humble cabbage roll.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_7a261f68-d9de-479: Now, you'll have a feast like you're in Tokyo itself.
values.Recorded_Media.json|RM_b3e6d349-2806-471: Hope to see you at The Wandering Sashimi soon!
