values.UI.json|UI_InventoryInfo: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> This is the Inventory Panel. <LINE> <LINE> <LEFT> <SIZE:small> Right click on loot items to show their uses - whether they can be eat, drunk, equipped or used in crafting recipes. <LINE> <LINE> You'll also find a list of the different bags and containers you carry here. Using these reduces your overall carry-weight. Click on them to see what's inside, and drag and drop their contents if you so choose. <LINE> <LINE> Click on the small arrow to expand the list of carried items. <LINE>  <LINE> <IMAGE:media/ui/icon.png> This icon means an item is currently equipped.
values.UI.json|UI_LootInfo: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> This is the Loot Panel. <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:small> <LEFT> The Loot Panel shows every container and cupboard within arm's reach of your character. Clicking on each will reveal the items inside. <LINE> <LINE> Items that have been placed nearby on the floor will also be visible. <LINE> <LINE> Clicking "Take All" will move all the contents of a container into your inventory. You can also drag and drop stacks of items.
values.UI.json|UI_HealthPanel: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> This is the Health Panel. <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:small> <LEFT> This screen shows injuries and the overall state of your body. <LINE> <LINE> To treat an injury: ensure you are carrying a relevant item (for example, a bandage) and right click on the wound before applying the dressing. (The bandage itself can also be selected and used.) <LINE> <LINE> <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Common Injuries <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:small> Scratch/Burn: Apply bandage and wait. Wound infection can be avoided by dousing it in alcohol or disinfectant. <LINE> <LINE> Deep Wound: Stitch with suture needle, using a suture needle holder for best results. Apply bandage. <LINE> <LINE> Embedded Glass Shard: Remove shards with tweezers or a suture needle holder. Apply bandage. <LINE> <LINE> Bleeding: Apply bandage. Change bandage regularly to prevent it getting dirty, and your wound becoming infected. <LINE> <LINE> Fracture: Create a splint using a ripped sheet and a piece of wood (eg. a branch). Apply splint. Wait a long period before recovery. <LINE> <LINE> Infected Wound: Douse bandage in disinfectant or alcohol. Apply bandage. Take antibiotics to fight infection. <LINE> <LINE> Lodged Bullet: Remove bullet with tweezers or a suture needle holder. Stitch then bandage. Remember to disinfect dressing with alcohol or disinfectant. <LINE> <LINE> Bite: Apply bandage and pray.
values.UI.json|UI_ClothingInsPanel: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> This is the Clothing Insulation Panel. <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:small> <LEFT> This screen shows how well your body parts are insulated. <LINE> <LINE> When in cold environments a good insulation is required. <LINE> <LINE> Though in the heat of summer you might want to cool yourself.
values.UI.json|UI_SkillPanel: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> This is the Skill Panel. <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:small> <LEFT> Every skill that you can learn is shown here. <LINE> <LINE> Learning speed depends on your chosen profession and traits. It can be accelerated by reading Skill Books - which provide an XP multiplier for that particular skill. <LINE> <LINE> XP is gained passively, through repeated actions throughout your survival experience, and improves the quality of your actions. <LINE> <LINE> Gaining skill XP also rewards you with a global XP. It is this that provides points to unlock the next level of each skill, once the previous level has been mastered.
values.UI.json|UI_CraftingUI: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> This is the Crafting Panel. <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:small> <LEFT> All recipes available to you are shown here in tabs that correspond to various Skills. <LINE> <LINE> Items are crafted from the loot carried in the inventory, and also automatically taken from anything at your feet or any containers that are within arm's reach. <LINE> <LINE> Many recipes, particularly in Cooking, require multiple items. To make a sandwich, for example, take bread slices then add any of range of different foodstuffs. <LINE> <LINE> More complex crafting recipes are often locked to certain Professions. However, these can be also be learned from Skill Magazines if you are of a high enough level. <LINE> <LINE> Crafting recipes can be quickly searched using the name filter, or added to your own personal favorite list.
values.UI.json|UI_CharacterCreation: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> This is the Character Creation screen. <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:small> <LEFT> A survivor's positive and negative attributes must be balanced. Points lost through useful traits must be cancelled out by points gained through hindering traits. Double-click on a trait to add it to your character. <LINE> <LINE> Spending points on a Profession provides skill boosts and often unlocks appropriate crafting recipes. <LINE> <LINE> Character presets can be saved and loaded at the bottom of the screen.
values.UI.json|UI_profdesc_lumberjack:
Slightly faster movement through forests and woodland.
Less muscle strain from chopping trees.
values.UI.json|UI_profdesc_parkranger: Much faster movement through forests and woodland.
values.UI.json|UI_trait_SmokerDesc:
Unhappiness rises when tobacco is not smoked.
Stress and unhappiness decrease after smoking tobacco.
values.UI.json|UI_optionscreen_showUsernameTool: Your username is always visible to others, but can be hidden on your own screen.
values.UI.json|UI_optionscreen_populateServerLi: Server list is loaded on opening the multiplayer tab but can be set to loading on game start.
values.UI.json|UI_Radio_IncreaseStepSize: Hold "Shift" key to increase step size.
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_AddUser: Use this command to add a new user to a whitelisted server. Use: /adduser "username" "password" -- password is optional
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_AddSteamID: Use this command to add a SteamID to a list of allowed SteamIDs on server. Use: /addSteamID "steamid"
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_RemoveSteamI: Use this command to remove a SteamID from a list of allowed SteamIDs on server. Use: /removeSteamID "steamid"
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_SetPassword: Use this command to change password for a user. Use: /setpassword "username" "newpassword"
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_Alarm: Sound a building alarm at the Admin's position. (Must be in a room)
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_Chopper: Place a helicopter event on a random player
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_Gunshot: Place a gunshot sound on a random player
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_StartRain: Starts raining on the server. Use /startrain "intensity", optional intensity is from 1 to 100
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_StartStorm: Starts a storm on the server. Use /startstorm "duration", optional duration is in game hours
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_Thunder: Use /thunder "username", username is optional except from the server console
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_Lightning: Use /lightning "username", username is optional except from the server console
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_ReloadOption: Reload server options (ServerOptions.ini) and send to clients
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_BanUser: Ban a user. Add a -ip to also ban the IP. Add a -r "reason" to specify a reason for the ban. Use: /banuser "username" -ip -r "reason". For example: /banuser "rj" -ip -r "spawn kill"
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_Kick: Kick a user. Add a -r "reason" to specify a reason for the kick. Use: /kickuser "username" -r "reason"
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_AddAllWhitel: Add all the current users who are connected with a password to the whitelist, so their account is protected.
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_AddWhitelist: Add a user connected with a password to the whitelist, so their account is protected. Use: /addusertowhitelist "username"
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_RemoveWhitel: Remove a user from the whitelist. Use: /removeuserfromwhitelist "username"
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_ShowOptions: Show the list of current server options and values.
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_ChangeOption: Change a server option. Use: /changeoption optionName "newValue"
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_GodMod: Make yourself invincible. Use: /godmode -value, ex /godmode -true (could be -false)
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_GodModPlayer: Make a player invincible. Use: /godmodeplayer "username" -value, ex /godmodeplayer "rj" -true (could be -false)
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_Invisible: Make yourself invisible to zombies. Use: /invisible -value, ex /invisible -true (could be -false)
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_InvisiblePla: Make a player invisible to zombies. Use: /invisibleplayer "username" -value, ex /invisibleplayer "rj" -true (could be -false)
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_AddItem: Give an item to a player. If no username is given then you will receive the item yourself. Count is optional. Use: /additem "username" "module.item" count. Example: /additem "rj" Base.Axe 5
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_RemoveItem: Remove items from yourself. Removes all items of type if count set to 0. Use: /removeitem "module.item" count. Example: /removeitem Base.Axe 5
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_AddKey: Give a key to a player. If no username is given then you will receive the item yourself. Key name is optional. Use: /addkey "username" "keyId" "name". Example: /addkey "rj" "7295
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_AddVehicle: Spawn a vehicle. Use: /addvehicle "script" "user or x,y,z", ex /addvehicle "Base.VanAmbulance" "rj"
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_CreateHorde: Spawn a horde near a player. Use : /createhorde count "username". Example /createhorde 150 "rj" Username is optional except from the server console. With no username the horde will be created around you
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_Statistics: Get server statistics. Use /stats help to get the details
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_Worldgen: Control full world generator. Use commands '/worldgen start', '/worldgen recheck', '/worldgen stop', and '/worldgen status'. Use
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_ServerMsg: Broadcast a message to all connected players. Use: /servermsg "My Message"
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_AddXp: Give XP to a player. Use /addxp "playername" perkname=xp -true. Example /addxp "rj" Woodwork=2 -true. The last argument is optional and is used to take xp multiplier into account
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_Teleport: Teleport to a player. Once teleported, wait for the map to appear. Use /teleport "playername" or /teleport "player1" "player2". Example /teleport "rj" or /teleport "rj" "toUser"
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_TeleportPlay: Teleport a player to another player. Use /teleportplayer "player1" "player2". Example /teleportplayer "rj" "toUser"
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_SendPulse: Toggle sending server performance info to this client. Use /sendpulse
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_NoClip: Makes a player pass through walls and structures. Toggles with no value. Use: /noclip "username" -value. Example /noclip "rj" -true (could be -false)
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_ReloadLua: Reload a Lua script on the server. Use /reloadlua "filename"
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_TeleportTo: Teleport to coordinates. Use /teleportto x,y,z. Example /teleportto 10000,11000,0
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_SetAccessLev: Set access level of a player. Current levels: Admin, Moderator, Overseer, GM, Observer. Use /setaccesslevel "username" "accesslevel". Example /setaccesslevel "rj" "moderator"
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_Roll: If you have dice, you can roll a random number - up to 100. Use: /roll 6
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_Card: If you have a card deck, you can draw a random card. Use: /card
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_VoiceBan: Block voice from user "username". Use /voiceban "username" -value. Example /voiceban "rj" -true (could be -false)
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_SafeHouse: Release a safehouse you own. Use /releasesafehouse
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_AddToSafehou: Adds player to a safehouse. Use /addtosafehouse "title" "username"
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_KickFromSafe: Removes player from a safehouse. Use /kickfromsafehouse "title" "username"
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_Replay: Record and play replay for moving player. Use /replay "playername" -record|-play|-stop filename. Example: /replay user1 -record stadion.bin
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_SetStatistic: Set and clear server statistics. Use /stats none|file|console|all period. Example /stats file 10
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_SetTimeSpeed: Set the time multiplier on the server. Use /setTimeSpeed period. Example /setTimeSpeed 10
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptions_SpawnRegionFile: -- This file was automatically generated when the server was first started.
-- Clients connecting to the server can choose to spawn in one of the following spawn regions.
-- The administrator can add as many different spawn regions as they want.
-- Defines a custom spawn point that spawns the player in Twiggy's Bar in West Point.
Uncomment the line below to add a custom spawnpoint for this server.
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_Disconnect: Kicks a client according to their connection number. Connection numbers can be seen through /connections. Use /disconnect index. Example /disconnect 2
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_RemoveMapSym: Removes all shared in-game map symbols for a specific user. Use /removemapsymbolsforuser "username"
values.UI.json|UI_optionscreen_ColorblindPatter: Use patterned textures for buildings in the in-game map.
values.UI.json|UI_optionscreen_enableDyslexicFo: When enabled, text will be written using the OpenDyslexia font if your language is supported.
values.UI.json|UI_optionscreen_disableLightning: When enabled, lightning will not be generated during storms.
values.UI.json|UI_TradingUIHelp: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> Use this UI to safely trade with others. <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:small> <LEFT> You need to add items from your main inventory to the "Your offer" list to add items to trade. Items from your backpack or ground can't be added. <LINE> <LINE> When you're done with your offer, you have to click the tickbox "Seal your offer". When both players have clicked this box, one of you can click the "Accept Deal" button to transfer all the items. <LINE> <LINE> If the other player changes their offer while you have sealed yours, you'll have to seal it again.
values.UI.json|UI_MapConflict: Overlap conflict between %1 and %2 on cell %3
values.UI.json|UI_mods_ConflictDetected: There are overlaps between your chosen custom maps. To prioritise which map appears on the overlap, click this button.
values.UI.json|UI_MapModsConflict: Return to the Mods menu to resolve overlap conflicts between custom maps.
values.UI.json|UI_ModsConflictsInfo: Resolve mapping overlap conflicts by setting a priority order for your chosen custom maps. <LINE> <LINE> Higher priority map mods will not have areas removed when lower priority maps overlap them. <LINE> <LINE> Maps closer to the top of the list have higher priority than maps lower down. If two maps overlap in the game world, areas of the higher-priority maps will be used.
values.UI.json|UI_ModsConflicts_ButtonMoveUp_to: Raise priority of the selected map.
values.UI.json|UI_ModsConflicts_ButtonMoveDown_: Lower priority of the selected map.
values.UI.json|UI_optionscreen_gamepad_preset_D: Reset all values to default as hard-coded. Movement axis to Walk+Run. RTrigger to PrecisionAim+Shoot.
values.UI.json|UI_optionscreen_gamepad_preset_O: Set all bindings to 'original'. RTrigger to Run, B to Sprint. PrecisionAim with ranged weapons.
values.UI.json|UI_ControllerTest_AY4exit: Press A and Y buttons for exit
values.UI.json|UI_trait_Mechanics2Desc: Familiar with the maintenance and repair of all vehicle models on the roads of Kentucky.
values.UI.json|UI_Vehicle_HeaterNeedKey: Start the vehicle or put keys in ignition to start heater.
values.UI.json|UI_Vehicle_WindowOpen: Open vehicle windows will counteract heater.
values.UI.json|UI_has_no_right_to_execute_comma: Player "%1" has not right to execute "%2" command
values.UI.json|UI_worldscreen_SavefileVehicle: Due to the extent of changes required to implement vehicles, saves from earlier versions are non-compatible. <LINE> <LINE> To continue this game: access the pre-vehicles Build 38.30 via the Steam betas tab. <LINE> <LINE> SavedGameWorldVersion: %1 CurrentWorldVersion: %2
values.UI.json|UI_worldscreen_SavefileAnimation: Due to the extent of changes required to implement animations, saves from earlier versions are not compatible. <LINE> <LINE> Savefile World Version: %1 <LINE> Current World Version: %2
values.UI.json|UI_chat_wrong_tab: Chat command "%3" is not available in tab "%1". Use tab "%2" instead.
values.UI.json|UI_chat_general_chat_disabled: General chat disabled by server. Contact admins for info
values.UI.json|UI_chat_whisper_message_to_yours: You cannot send message to yourself
values.UI.json|UI_servers_needPwd: Please enter a password for your account to protect it.
values.UI.json|UI_servers_notvalid_username: Username must be at least 3 chars long, 20 chars max and not contains any of the following: ; . ' ? \ / @ $
values.UI.json|UI_optionscreen_DblTapRunToSprin: If ticked, double-tapping %1 will start sprinting. \n Hold %2 to continue sprinting.
values.UI.json|UI_NewGame_Apocalypse_desc: The canon Zomboid experience. Take your time, be careful, and watch your back.
values.UI.json|UI_NewGame_Outbreak_desc: An accelerated experience for players with less gaming time. Less grind, more loot, same lethality.
values.UI.json|UI_NewGame_Extinction_desc: A brutal world. Everything wants you dead. Some zombies run. Not recommended for newer players.
values.UI.json|UI_NewGame_Rising_desc: A cozier environment for those who dream of the perfect survivor homestead. Less stress, tamer zombies.
values.UI.json|UI_NewGame_Sandbox_desc2: Tailor design your own difficulty and play style.
values.UI.json|UI_News_Anim:
WELCOME TO THE BUILD 41 PUBLIC BETA!
This is a Work in Progress version of the biggest code update PZ has ever had. There will be bugs and balance issues. Optimization improvements are ongoing. Some features have been temporarily disabled. If you have issues: don't get mad, get involved. Let us know on our forums.
values.UI.json|UI_TermsOfService_Title: TERMS OF SERVICE AND PRIVACY NOTICE
values.UI.json|UI_TermsOfService_Prompt1:
Greetings doomed survivor! Before your infection sets in...
By selecting ACCEPT, you agree to our Terms of Service and acknowledge the Privacy Policy.
values.UI.json|UI_TermsOfService_Prompt2: [Clicking these buttons will display a page in your web browser.]
values.UI.json|UI_OnConnectFailed_DebugNotAllow: Debug connection is not allowed for non admin.
values.UI.json|UI_foraging_Warning: Foraging has changed! It is now based on searching for items. Click the magnifying glass icon on the left side of the UI. Use the End key to toggle searching on/off.
values.UI.json|UI_BadWordCheck: The word, letters or phrase %1 cannot be used during server creation. Please try again.
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOption_AntiCheatPacketE: Disables packet exception checks anti-cheat protection.
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOption_MultiplayerStati: Sets the multiplayer update period in seconds. Statistics is disabled if value is 0.
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOption_HideAdminsInPlay: Hides admins in the player list.
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOption_MaxPacketsPerSec: Sets the limit for processing network packets from each client on the server.
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOption_ShowCoordinates_: Shows player character coordinates in the lower right corner.
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOption_Seed_tooltip:
The worldgen seed used to generate the world.
If you want to change this, put a new value in and delete map_worldgen.bin in your save directory.
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOption_MapRemotePlayerV: Controls display of remote players on the in-game map.\n1=Hidden 2=Friends 3=Friends and nearby players 4=Everyone
values.UI.json|UI_ServerOptionDesc_CheckModsNee: Indicates whether a mod has been updated. Writes answer to log file
values.UI.json|UI_mods_backAccept: Save changes to a set of mods?
values.UI.json|UI_mods_openModUrl: Do you want to go to the mod's website?
values.UI.json|UI_modselector_modTemplateWarn: "This is template for modders. Better not to use it.\nEnable mod?"
values.UI.json|UI_modselector_usupportText1: Version modifications created for a version\nless than
values.UI.json|UI_modselector_usupportText2: can only be run in debug mode.
values.UI.json|UI_modselector_help1: Important Mods from Build 41 and older builds must be updated for Build 42. You need to enable the "Show unsupported mods" option in Debug mode to run older mods.
values.UI.json|UI_modselector_help2: List of mods and filters On the left is a list of mods. You can filter them to only show enabled mods or your favorites, and search by name, ModID or WorkshopID. To enable a mod, click on its checkbox. To add a mod to your favorites, click on the star.
values.UI.json|UI_modselector_help3: Presets and sharing mod lists To create a mod selection preset, turn on the mods you want to add to the preset, and click SAVE under the list of mods. The DEL button will delete the preset. To share the preset you created, select a preset and click the SHARE button. After that, a line of text with the mods will be added to your clipboard. You can send the text to someone who can add the mods to their game with the ADD button.
values.UI.json|UI_modselector_help4: Mod description On the right side of the screen is a description of the selected mod, which includes screenshots of the mod and a description of its parameters. It may also include links to sites that will open in your browser, and links to dependencies for the mod to work, or incompatibilities between this mod and others.
values.UI.json|UI_modselector_help5: Mod order Using the Mod Order button, you can change the order in which mods are loaded. They can be ordered automatically, or moved using the mouse (by clicking on the move icon and dragging the mod) or a gamepad. Mods towards the top are loaded first. Changing the order of mods may help with errors.
values.UI.json|UI_modselector_help6: <H2> Map order <LINE> <TEXT> In the case of map conflicts, the Map Order button will be available. Maps higher on the order will be given priority, and loaded over maps lower down.
values.UI.json|UI_credits_UsesBinkVideo1: Copyright © 1997-2025 by Epic Games Tools LLC
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip1: You can shoot from inside a vehicle if your window is open.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip2: Keep accidentally Shouting? You can change the keybind in the Options menu.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip3: Putting items in your belt or holster lets you access them quicker, and reduces their weight.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip4: Schools are a great location to find low level Skill Books.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip5: Hunting for Magazines? Don't forget to check mailboxes.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip6: Gain Strength and Fitness using the exercise options on the Health menu. Carrying heavy objects will help too.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip7: Need Clay? Find it through Foraging, in schools, or in deposits beside rivers. You need a Shovel and a Sack to collect Clay deposits.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip8: You need a hose and an appropriate container to siphon gas from cars.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip9: Have a varied diet if you don't want to lose or gain too much weight.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip10: Set an alarm on your watch or clock to make sure you don't oversleep.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip11: Worried about your faucets running dry? Wells are hard to find, but provide large amounts of clean Water.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip12: Press C to crouch and move stealthily. Stick close to walls and your character will crouch down lower, and will be harder to spot.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip13: Some knives can do a "jaw stab" that instantly kills zombies. But beware - your knife can also get stuck.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip14: The keys to a car are sometimes found on the ground or in a nearby building, or in the pockets of a local zombie.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip15: Railyards are a great source for heavy tools.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip16: Wound infection (NOT Knox Virus infection) can be avoided by using clean bandages. Sterilize bandages using disinfectant or boiling water.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip17: Accidentally closed your minimap? Hover over the map icon towards the upper left, then click the second map icon that pops out.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip18: Rotten food and Animal Dung in a composter will slowly turn into compost, which can be used to fertilize crops.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip19: Axes are likely to be be found in garages, sheds, or fire stations.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip20: Lost something on the ground? Use Search Mode on the Investigate Area menu to find it again.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip21: Your crops can be trampled by zombies, so make sure to grow them somewhere safe.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip22: Use Notepads, Journals, and similar items to keep track of your thoughts, make lists, or log your survival.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip23: Survivors will automatically drink the water kept in their main inventory, unless it has become tainted.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip24: Some zombies have maps made by ex-survivors. They may or may not lead you to treasure.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip25: If you press the Shout button while crouched, you will whisper. This attracts zombies from a much smaller radius.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip26: Equipping a Tissue or Toilet Paper will muffle the sound of your sneezes and coughs.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip27: Generators can be found in sheds, garages, or storage units.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip28: Your footwear you choose effects stomping damage, and the noise you make when moving.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip29: Tainted water can be used to water crops. To make it drinkable, it must be boiled.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip30: Wearing dirty or bloody clothes will make wound infection (but NOT Knox Virus Infection) more likely. Wash them with water, or in a washing machine.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip31: Normal zombies too slow? Turn on Sprinters in Sandbox for a new challenge.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip32: Press X (default) to clear the chamber of a jammed gun.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip33: Food can be frozen in a freezer - if it's powered - to last longer. Most frozen food must be thawed before eating.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip34: Sneaking uses slightly more energy than walking, but makes you less likely to be spotted.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip35: Advertising Fliers can reveal locations on your map. Click the button at the bottom of the window.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip36: Pick up or dismantle furniture using the "wooden locker" icon in the upper left of the screen.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip37: Using long melee weapons will exhaust you quicker than using short ones.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip38: You can read the back of retail VHS tapes for a quick plot synopsis before you watch them.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip39: Equip a Megaphone to give your shout more radius. Alternatively, try a Whistle.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip40: Standing near a large amount of dead bodies is bad for your health.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip41: Press V (default) near a car to open its Mechanics menu.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip42: Hold R (default) with a gun equipped for extra options related to ammo and reloading.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip43: Putting items in an equipped backpack reduces their weight.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip44: An animal will accept you the longer you stay with it. Petting it helps acceptance, and reduces your stress.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip45: An animal inside a Livestock Zone is automatically assigned to it, and will not leave even if the Zone is unfenced.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip46: Small animals can be picked up and carried. Large animals must be led on a rope, and can be tied to a posts and trees.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip47: Animals will eat food they find in their Zones, both from feeding troughs and from the ground.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip48: Animals can drink from puddles, troughs, or be given water from a container directly.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip49: Some items can only be crafted on a table or other hard surface (eg. a boulder or tree stump).
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip50: Some Recipes are automatically learned if your skills are high enough.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip51: Having a Crafting Recipe at hand will allow you to craft the item at one skill level lower.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip52: Muscle strain from melee weapons can be lowered by increasing Strength, and/or your skill in that weapon type.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip53: Double click a clothing item or weapon in your inventory to wear or equip it.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip54: Press F (default) to quickly equip and turn on a light source. Hold F for more advanced options.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip55: When driving, press Shift (default) to set the cruise control speed to your current speed. Shift+W will increase it, and Shift+S will decrease it.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip56: Hold left-Alt (default) to prioritize targeting downed zombies instead of standing ones.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip57: Toggle Search Mode with the End key (default).
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip58: Hold Q (default) to open the emote wheel.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip59: Equip a Pillow, or put one on your bed, for better quality sleep.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip_joke1: Louisville was founded in 1778 and named in honor of King Louis XVI of France.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip_joke2: Sixteen John Spiral movies were released between 1962 and 1993. Operation Fort Knox was filmed nearby!
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip_joke3: 90% of deaths are caused by taking unnecessary risks.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip_joke4: Bleach is a cleaning product, and should not be consumed.
values.UI.json|UI_quick_tip_joke5: The town of West Point, Kentucky was founded by the pioneer James Young, and officially established in 1796.
values.UI.json|UI_worldscreen_SavefileConversio: <H1> <LINE> <ORANGE> WARNING: <LINE> <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> Save conversion process will break saves. <LINE> <LINE> We strongly advise you to use back-up Steam betas to continue your save. <LINE> <LINE> Convert save?
values.UI.json|UI_EpilepsyWarning_3: This game may contain flashing lights, strobing effects, rapid visual changes, and patterns that may trigger seizures or
values.UI.json|UI_EpilepsyWarning_4: other adverse reactions in people with photosensitive epilepsy - even those without a prior history. If you or anyone in
values.UI.json|UI_EpilepsyWarning_5: your household has a history of epilepsy or seizures, please consult a doctor before playing.

values.Valley Station, KY.json|description: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> VALLEY STATION <LINE> <LINE><LEFT> <SIZE:small> Though only a short drive from Louisville along the Dixie Highway, Valley Station is rural life at its most relaxing. Spend a day watching the Ohio flow past. Go birdwatching, walking, or hunting in Jefferson Forest. <LINE> <LINE> When you're ready to return to civilization, visit Crossroads Mall for just about anything you can think of!
values.West Point, KY.json|description: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> WEST POINT <LINE> <LINE><LEFT> <SIZE:small> Whether you're strolling through the town square, browsing stores, or just chatting with friendly locals - West Point is true Small Town USA. <LINE> <LINE>Don't let sleepy streets, affordable housing and acres of rolling farmland fool you: this is a Knox Country administrative hub. If our Mayor isn't busy rubber-stamping public ordinances in the Town Hall, you might just find him in the famous Twiggy's Bar! No matter how long your stay, a West Point welcome is guaranteed.
